He washed his face thrice and after that he washed his forearms up to the elbows twice and then passed his wet hands over his head from its front to its back and vice versa (beginning from the front and taking them to the back of his head up to the nape of the neck and then brought them to the front again from where he had started) and washed his feet (up to the ankles).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 51; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 185

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب غَسْلِ الرِّجْلَيْنِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The washing of feet unto the ankles

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، شَهِدْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ أَبِي حَسَنٍ سَأَلَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ زَيْدٍ عَنْ وُضُوءِ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَعَا بِتَوْرٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ، فَتَوَضَّأَ لَهُمْ وُضُوءَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَأَكْفَأَ عَلَى يَدِهِ مِنَ التَّوْرِ، فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي التَّوْرِ، فَمَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ وَاسْتَنْثَرَ ثَلاَثَ غَرَفَاتٍ، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فَمَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ، فَأَقْبَلَ بِهِمَا وَأَدْبَرَ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: My father saw `Amr bin Abi Hasan asking `Abdullah bin Zaid about the ablution of the Prophet. `Abdullah bin Zaid asked for earthenware pot containing water and in front of them performed ablution like that of the Prophet (ﷺ) . He poured water from the pot over his hand and washed his hands thrice and then he put his hands in the pot and rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out with three handfuls of water. Again he put his hand in the water and washed his face thrice and washed his forearms up to the elbows twice; and then put his hands in the water and then passed them over his head by bringing them to the front and then to the rear of the head once, and then he washed his feet up to the ankles.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 52; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 186

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب اسْتِعْمَالِ فَضْلِ وَضُوءِ النَّاسِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The using of the remaining water after ablution
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَأَمَرَ جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَهْلَهُ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّئُوا بِفَضْلِ سِوَاكِهِ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: And Jarir bin ‘Abdullah ordered the members of his family to perform ablution with the water in which he had put his Siwak (a piece of a root of a tree called Al-Arak used as a toothbrush). ​​

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جُحَيْفَةَ ، يَقُولُ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْهَاجِرَةِ، فَأُتِيَ بِوَضُوءٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ، فَجَعَلَ النَّاسُ يَأْخُذُونَ مِنْ فَضْلِ وَضُوئِهِ فَيَتَمَسَّحُونَ بِهِ، فَصَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الظُّهْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَالْعَصْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَبَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ عَنَزَةٌ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us at noon and water for ablution was brought to him. After he had performed ablution, the remaining water was taken by the people and they started smearing their bodies with it (as a blessed thing). The Prophet (ﷺ) offered two rak`at of the Zuhr prayer and then two rak`at of the `Asr prayer while a short spear (or stick) was there (as a Sutra) in front of him.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 53; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 187

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: وَقَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى دَعَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقَدَحٍ فِيهِ مَاءٌ، فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ وَوَجْهَهُ فِيهِ، وَمَجَّ فِيهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُمَا
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: اشْرَبَا مِنْهُ، وَأَفْرِغَا عَلَى وُجُوهِكُمَا وَنُحُورِكُمَا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet asked for a tumbler containing water and washed both his hands and face in it and then threw a mouthful of water in the tumbler and said to both of us (Abu Musa and Bilal), "Drink from the tumbler and pour some of its water on your faces and chests."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 54; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 187

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَحْمُودُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ ، قَالَ وَهُوَ الَّذِي مَجَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي وَجْهِهِ وَهْوَ غُلاَمٌ مِنْ بِئْرِهِمْ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عُرْوَةُ عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ وَغَيْرِهِ يُصَدِّقُ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا صَاحِبَهُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: وَإِذَا تَوَضَّأَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَادُوا يَقْتَتِلُونَ عَلَى وَضُوئِهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi` who was the person on whose face the Prophet (ﷺ) had ejected a mouthful of water from his family's well while he was a boy, and `Urwa (on the authority of Al-Miswar and others) who testified each other, said, "Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) , performed ablution, his companions were nearly fighting for the remains of the water."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 55; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 188

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter:

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ يُونُسَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ، عَنِ الْجَعْدِ ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ السَّائِبَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ ، يَقُولُ ذَهَبَتْ بِي خَالَتِي إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ ابْنَ أُخْتِي وَجِعٌ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: ‏.‏ فَمَسَحَ رَأْسِي وَدَعَا لِي بِالْبَرَكَةِ، ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ فَشَرِبْتُ مِنْ وَضُوئِهِ، ثُمَّ قُمْتُ خَلْفَ ظَهْرِهِ، فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَى خَاتَمِ النُّبُوَّةِ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ مِثْلِ زِرِّ الْحَجَلَةِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: My aunt took me to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This son of my sister has got a disease in his legs." So he passed his hands on my head and prayed for Allah's blessings for me; then he performed ablution and I drank from the remaining water. I stood behind him and saw the seal of Prophethood between his shoulders, and it was like the "Zir-al-Hijla" (means the button of a small tent, but some said 'egg of a partridge.' etc.)
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 56; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 189

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَنْ مَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ مِنْ غَرْفَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Rinsing one's mouth and putting water in one's nose and cleaning it by blowing the water out with a single handful of water

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ، أَنَّهُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَفْرَغَ مِنَ الإِنَاءِ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ فَغَسَلَهُمَا، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ أَوْ مَضْمَضَ، وَاسْتَنْشَقَ مِنْ كَفَّةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ، فَفَعَلَ ذَلِكَ ثَلاَثًا، فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ، وَمَسَحَ بِرَأْسِهِ مَا أَقْبَلَ وَمَا أَدْبَرَ، وَغَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ هَكَذَا وُضُوءُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: (on the authority of his father) `Abdullah bin Zaid poured water on his hands from a utensil containing water and washed them and then with one handful of water he rinsed his mouth and cleaned his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out. He repeated it thrice. He, then, washed his hands and forearms up to the elbows twice and passed wet hands over his head, both forwards and backwards, and washed his feet up to the ankles and said, "This is the ablution of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 57; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 190

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَسْحِ الرَّأْسِ مَرَّةً
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The passing of wet hands over the head once only (while performing ablution)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ أَبِي حَسَنٍ سَأَلَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ زَيْدٍ عَنْ وُضُوءِ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَعَا بِتَوْرٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ، فَتَوَضَّأَ لَهُمْ،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَكَفَأَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ فَغَسَلَهُمَا ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ، فَمَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ، وَاسْتَنْثَرَ ثَلاَثًا بِثَلاَثِ غَرَفَاتٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ، فَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ، فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ، فَمَسَحَ بِرَأْسِهِ فَأَقْبَلَ بِيَدَيْهِ وَأَدْبَرَ بِهِمَا، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ فَغَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ قَالَ مَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ مَرَّةً
Hadith_List.Matn_English: My father said, "I saw `Amr bin Abi Hasan asking `Abdullah bin Zaid about the ablution of the Prophet. `Abdullah bin Zaid asked for an earthenware pot containing water and performed ablution in front of them. He poured water over his hands and washed them thrice. Then he put his (right) hand in the pot and rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out thrice with three handfuls of water Again he put his hand in the water and washed his face thrice. After that he put his hand in the pot and washed his forearms up to the elbows twice and then again put his hand in the water and passed wet hands over his head by bringing them to the front and then to the back and once more he put his hand in the pot and washed his feet (up to the ankles.)" Narrated Wuhaib: That he (the Prophet (ﷺ) in narration 191 above) had passed his wet hands on the head once only.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 58; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 191

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب وُضُوءِ الرَّجُلِ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ وَفَضْلِ وَضُوءِ الْمَرْأَةِ‏
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The performance of ablution by a man along with his wife. The utilization of water remaining after a woman has performed ablution. Umar performed ablution with warm water and with water brought from the house of a Christian woman
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَتَوَضَّأَ عُمَرُ بِالْحَمِيمِ مِنْ بَيْتِ نَصْرَانِيَّةٍ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: 'Umar performed ablution with warm water and with water brought from the house of a Christian woman.

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: كَانَ الرِّجَالُ وَالنِّسَاءُ يَتَوَضَّئُونَ فِي زَمَانِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَمِيعًا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: "During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) men and women used to perform ablution together."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 59; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 192

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب صَبِّ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَضُوءَهُ عَلَى الْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The sprinkling of remaining water after performing ablution on an unconscious person by the prophet (saw)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا ، يَقُولُ جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُنِي، وَأَنَا مَرِيضٌ لاَ أَعْقِلُ،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَتَوَضَّأَ وَصَبَّ عَلَىَّ مِنْ وَضُوئِهِ
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ، فَعَقَلْتُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لِمَنِ الْمِيرَاثُ إِنَّمَا يَرِثُنِي كَلاَلَةٌ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ آيَةُ الْفَرَائِضِ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to visit me while I was sick and unconscious. He performed ablution and sprinkled the remaining water on me and I became conscious and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! To whom will my inheritance go as I have neither ascendants nor descendants?" Then the Divine verses regarding Fara'id (inheritance) were revealed.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 60; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 193

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الْغُسْلِ وَالْوُضُوءِ فِي الْمِخْضَبِ وَالْقَدَحِ وَالْخَشَبِ وَالْحِجَارَةِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To take a bath or perform ablution from a Mikhdab (utensil), a tumbler, or a wooden or stone pot

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُنِيرٍ ، سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ بَكْرٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ حَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ، فَقَامَ مَنْ كَانَ قَرِيبَ الدَّارِ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ، وَبَقِيَ قَوْمٌ،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَأُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِخْضَبٍ مِنْ حِجَارَةٍ فِيهِ مَاءٌ، فَصَغُرَ الْمِخْضَبُ أَنْ يَبْسُطَ فِيهِ كَفَّهُ، فَتَوَضَّأَ الْقَوْمُ كُلُّهُمْ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: قُلْنَا كَمْ كُنْتُمْ قَالَ ثَمَانِينَ وَزِيَادَةً
Hadith_List.Matn_English: It was the time for prayer, and those whose houses were near got up and went to their people (to perform ablution), and there remained some people (sitting). Then a painted stove pot (Mikhdab) containing water was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)s The pot was small, not broad enough for one to spread one's hand in; yet all the people performed ablution. (The sub narrator said, "We asked Anas, 'How many persons were you?' Anas replied 'We were eighty or more"). (It was one of the miracles of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 61; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 194

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: دَعَا بِقَدَحٍ فِيهِ مَاءٌ، فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ وَوَجْهَهُ فِيهِ وَمَجَّ فِيهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Once the Prophet (ﷺ) asked for a tumbler containing water. He washed his hands and face in it and also threw a mouthful of water in it.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 62; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 195

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ، قَالَ أَتَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْرَجْنَا لَهُ مَاءً فِي تَوْرٍ مِنْ صُفْرٍ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَتَوَضَّأَ، فَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ ثَلاَثًا وَيَدَيْهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ، وَمَسَحَ بِرَأْسِهِ فَأَقْبَلَ بِهِ وَأَدْبَرَ، وَغَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us and we brought out water for him in a brass pot. He performed ablution thus: He washed his face thrice, and his forearms to the elbows twice, then passed his wet hands lightly over the head from front to rear and brought them to front again and washed his feet (up to the ankles).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 63; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 196

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا ثَقُلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاشْتَدَّ بِهِ وَجَعُهُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: ، اسْتَأْذَنَ أَزْوَاجَهُ فِي أَنْ يُمَرَّضَ فِي بَيْتِي، فَأَذِنَّ لَهُ، فَخَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ تَخُطُّ رِجْلاَهُ فِي الأَرْضِ بَيْنَ عَبَّاسٍ وَرَجُلٍ آخَرَ‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَأَخْبَرْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ أَتَدْرِي مَنِ الرَّجُلُ الآخَرُ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ هُوَ عَلِيٌّ‏.‏ وَكَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ تُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ بَعْدَ مَا دَخَلَ بَيْتَهُ وَاشْتَدَّ وَجَعُهُ ‏"‏ هَرِيقُوا عَلَىَّ مِنْ سَبْعِ قِرَبٍ، لَمْ تُحْلَلْ أَوْكِيَتُهُنَّ، لَعَلِّي أَعْهَدُ إِلَى النَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأُجْلِسَ فِي مِخْضَبٍ لِحَفْصَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ طَفِقْنَا نَصُبُّ عَلَيْهِ تِلْكَ حَتَّى طَفِقَ يُشِيرُ إِلَيْنَا أَنْ قَدْ فَعَلْتُنَّ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَى النَّاسِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: When the ailment of the Prophet (ﷺ) became aggravated and his disease became severe, he asked his wives to permit him to be nursed (treated) in my house. So they gave him the permission. Then the Prophet came (to my house) with the support of two men, and his legs were dragging on the ground, between `Abbas, and another man." 'Ubaidullah (the sub narrator) said, "I informed `Abdullah bin `Abbas of what `Aisha said. Ibn `Abbas said: 'Do you know who was the other man?' I replied in the negative. Ibn `Abbas said, 'He was `Ali (bin Abi Talib)." `Aisha further said, "When the Prophet (ﷺ) came to my house and his sickness became aggravated he ordered us to pour seven skins full of water on him, so that he might give some advice to the people. So he was seated in a Mikhdab (brass tub) belonging to Hafsa, the wife of the Prophet. Then, all of us started pouring water on him from the water skins till he beckoned to us to stop and that we have done (what he wanted us to do). After that he went out to the people."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 64; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 197

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الْوُضُوءِ مِنَ التَّوْرِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To perform ablution from an earthen-ware pot

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ كَانَ عَمِّي يُكْثِرُ مِنَ الْوُضُوءِ، قَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ أَخْبِرْنِي كَيْفَ رَأَيْتَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَوَضَّأُ فَدَعَا بِتَوْرٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَكَفَأَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ فَغَسَلَهُمَا ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي التَّوْرِ، فَمَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْثَرَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ مِنْ غَرْفَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فَاغْتَرَفَ بِهَا فَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ مَاءً، فَمَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ، فَأَدْبَرَ بِيَدَيْهِ وَأَقْبَلَ ثُمَّ غَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ هَكَذَا رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَوَضَّأُ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: (on the authority of his father) My uncle used to perform ablution extravagantly and once he asked `Abdullah bin Zaid to tell him how he had seen the Prophet (ﷺ) performing ablution. He asked for an earthenware pot containing water, and poured water from it on his hands and washed them thrice, and then put his hand in the earthenware pot and rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out thrice with one handful of water; he again put his hand in the water and took a handful of water and washed his face thrice, then washed his hands up to the elbows twice, and took water with his hand, and passed it over his head from front to back and then from back to front, and then washed his feet (up to the ankles) and said, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) performing ablution in that way."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 65; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 198

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: دَعَا بِإِنَاءٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ، فَأُتِيَ بِقَدَحٍ رَحْرَاحٍ فِيهِ شَىْءٌ مِنْ مَاءٍ، فَوَضَعَ أَصَابِعَهُ فِيهِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَجَعَلْتُ أَنْظُرُ إِلَى الْمَاءِ يَنْبُعُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ، قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَحَزَرْتُ مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ مَا بَيْنَ السَّبْعِينَ إِلَى الثَّمَانِينَ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Anas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for water and a tumbler with a broad base and no so deep, containing a small quantity of water, was brought to him whereby he put his fingers in it." Anas further said, ' noticed the water springing out from amongst his fingers." Anas added, ' estimated that the people who performed ablution with it numbered between seventy to eighty."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 66; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 199

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الْوُضُوءِ بِالْمُدِّ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To perform ablution with one Mudd of water. (Mudd is practically 2/3 of the kilogram)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ جَبْرٍ ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا ، يَقُولُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَغْسِلُ ـ أَوْ كَانَ يَغْتَسِلُ ـ بِالصَّاعِ إِلَى خَمْسَةِ أَمْدَادٍ، وَيَتَوَضَّأُ بِالْمُدِّ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to take a bath with one Sa` up to five Mudds (1 Sa` = [??] Mudds) of water and used to perform ablution with one Mudd of water.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 67; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 200

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الْمَسْحِ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To pass wet hands over Khuffain [two leather socks covering the ankles]

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَصْبَغُ بْنُ الْفَرَجِ الْمِصْرِيُّ ، عَنِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو النَّضْرِ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَنَّهُ مَسَحَ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: وَأَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ سَأَلَ عُمَرَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ إِذَا حَدَّثَكَ شَيْئًا سَعْدٌ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلاَ تَسْأَلْ عَنْهُ غَيْرَهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو النَّضْرِ أَنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ سَعْدًا حَدَّثَهُ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) passed wet hands over his Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)." `Abdullah bin `Umar asked `Umar about it. `Umar replied in the affirmative and added, "Whenever Sa`d narrates a Hadith from the Prophet, there is no need to ask anyone else about it."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 68; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 201

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ خَالِدٍ الْحَرَّانِيُّ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ خَرَجَ لِحَاجَتِهِ فَاتَّبَعَهُ الْمُغِيرَةُ بِإِدَاوَةٍ فِيهَا مَاءٌ، فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِ حِينَ فَرَغَ مِنْ حَاجَتِهِ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: ، فَتَوَضَّأَ وَمَسَحَ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out to answer the call of nature and I followed him with a tumbler containing water, and when he finished, I poured water and he performed ablution and passed wet hands over his Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 69; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 202

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ الضَّمْرِيِّ ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، رَأَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَمْسَحُ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: وَتَابَعَهُ حَرْبُ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ وَأَبَانُ عَنْ يَحْيَى
Hadith_List.Narrator_English: Narrated Ja`far bin `Amr bin Umaiya Ad-Damri:
Hadith_List.Matn_English: My father said, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) passing wet hands over his Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 70; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 203

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَمْسَحُ عَلَى عِمَامَتِهِ وَخُفَّيْهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: وَتَابَعَهُ مَعْمَرٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَمْرٍو قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_English: My father said, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) passing wet hands over his turban and Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 71; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 204

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب إِذَا أَدْخَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ وَهُمَا طَاهِرَتَانِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: If one puts on (Khuff) just after performing ablution (ther is no need to wash one's feet again in ablution) (24 hours for non-travellers and three days for travelers)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ، فَأَهْوَيْتُ لأَنْزِعَ خُفَّيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: دَعْهُمَا، فَإِنِّي أَدْخَلْتُهُمَا طَاهِرَتَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَمَسَحَ عَلَيْهِمَا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: My father said, "Once I was in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey and I dashed to take off his Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather). He ordered me to leave them as he had put them after performing ablution. So he passed wet hands over them.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 72; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 205

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَنْ لَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ مِنْ لَحْمِ الشَّاةِ وَالسَّوِيقِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Not repeating ablution after eating mutton and As-Sawiq
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَأَكَلَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ وَعُثْمَانُ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ لَحْمًا فَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّئُوا.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: Abu Bakr, ‘Umar, and ‘Uthman ate such food but did not repeat ablution. ​​

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ،‏.‏ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَكَلَ كَتِفَ شَاةٍ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ate a piece of cooked mutton from the shoulder region and prayed without repeating ablution.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 73; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 206

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، رَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَحْتَزُّ مِنْ كَتِفِ شَاةٍ، فَدُعِيَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ فَأَلْقَى السِّكِّينَ فَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: My father said, "I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) taking a piece of (cooked) mutton from the shoulder region and then he was called for prayer. He put his knife down and prayed without repeating ablution."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 74; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 207

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَنْ مَضْمَضَ مِنَ السَّوِيقِ وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Rinsing one's mouth (with water) after eating As-Sawiq without repaying ablution

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ ، مَوْلَى بَنِي حَارِثَةَ أَنَّ سُوَيْدَ بْنَ النُّعْمَانِ ، أَخْبَرَهُ‏.‏ أَنَّهُ، خَرَجَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ خَيْبَرَ، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانُوا بِالصَّهْبَاءِ ـ وَهِيَ أَدْنَى خَيْبَرَ ـ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَصَلَّى الْعَصْرَ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِالأَزْوَادِ، فَلَمْ يُؤْتَ إِلاَّ بِالسَّوِيقِ، فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَثُرِّيَ، فَأَكَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَكَلْنَا، ثُمَّ قَامَ إِلَى الْمَغْرِبِ، فَمَضْمَضَ وَمَضْمَضْنَا، ثُمَّ صَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: In the year of the conquest of Khaibar I went with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) till we reached Sahba, a place near Khaibar, where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the `Asr prayer and asked for food. Nothing but saweeq was brought. He ordered it to be moistened with water. He and all of us ate it and the Prophet (ﷺ) got up for the evening prayer (Maghrib prayer), rinsed his mouth with water and we did the same, and he then prayed without repeating the ablution.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 75; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 208

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَصْبَغُ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو ، عَنْ بُكَيْرٍ ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَكَلَ عِنْدَهَا كَتِفًا، ثُمَّ صَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) ate (a piece of) mutton from the shoulder region and then prayed without repeating the ablution.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 76; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 209

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب هَلْ يُمَضْمِضُ مِنَ اللَّبَنِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Whether to rinse the mouth after drinking milk

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: شَرِبَ لَبَنًا، فَمَضْمَضَ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ لَهُ دَسَمًا ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ يُونُسُ وَصَالِحُ بْنُ كَيْسَانَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drank milk, rinsed his mouth and said, "It has fat."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 77; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 210

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: بَابُ الْوُضُوءِ مِنَ النَّوْمِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَرَ مِنَ النَّعْسَةِ وَالنَّعْسَتَيْنِ أَوِ الْخَفْقَةِ وُضُوءًا
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Ablution after sleep. And whoever considers it unnecessary to repeat ablution after dozing once or twice or after nodding once in slumber

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا نَعَسَ أَحَدُكُمْ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي فَلْيَرْقُدْ حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ عَنْهُ النَّوْمُ، فَإِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا صَلَّى وَهُوَ نَاعِسٌ لاَ يَدْرِي لَعَلَّهُ يَسْتَغْفِرُ فَيَسُبَّ نَفْسَهُ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you feels drowsy while praying he should go to bed (sleep) till his slumber is over because in praying while drowsy one does not know whether one is asking for forgiveness or for a bad thing for oneself."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 78; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 211

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا نَعَسَ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَلْيَنَمْ حَتَّى يَعْلَمَ مَا يَقْرَأُ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you feels drowsy while praying, he should sleep till he understands what he is saying (reciting).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 79; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 212

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الْوُضُوءِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَدَثٍ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To perform ablution even on having no Hadath

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَامِرٍ ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عَامِرٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَتَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: قُلْتُ كَيْفَ كُنْتُمْ تَصْنَعُونَ قَالَ يُجْزِئُ أَحَدَنَا الْوُضُوءُ مَا لَمْ يُحْدِثْ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Anas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to perform ablution for every prayer." I asked Anas, "What did you used to do?' Anas replied, "We used to pray with the same ablution until we break it with Hadath."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 80; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 213

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي بُشَيْرُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ خَيْبَرَ، حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِالصَّهْبَاءِ، صَلَّى لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعَصْرَ، فَلَمَّا صَلَّى دَعَا بِالأَطْعِمَةِ، فَلَمْ يُؤْتَ إِلاَّ بِالسَّوِيقِ، فَأَكَلْنَا وَشَرِبْنَا، ثُمَّ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْمَغْرِبِ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَمَضْمَضَ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى لَنَا الْمَغْرِبَ وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: In the year of the conquest of Khaibar I went with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) till we reached As-Sahba' where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led the `Asr prayer and asked for the food. Nothing but saweeq was brought and we ate it and drank (water). The Prophet (ﷺ) got up for the (Maghrib) Prayer, rinsed his mouth with water and then led the prayer without repeating the ablution.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 81; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 214

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مِنَ الْكَبَائِرِ أَنْ لاَ يَسْتَتِرَ مِنْ بَوْلِهِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: One of the major sins is not to protect oneself (one's clothes and body) from one's urine (i.e., from being soiled with it)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، قَالَ مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِحَائِطٍ مِنْ حِيطَانِ الْمَدِينَةِ أَوْ مَكَّةَ، فَسَمِعَ صَوْتَ إِنْسَانَيْنِ يُعَذَّبَانِ فِي قُبُورِهِمَا، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يُعَذَّبَانِ، وَمَا يُعَذَّبَانِ فِي كَبِيرٍ ‏"‏، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَى، كَانَ أَحَدُهُمَا لاَ يَسْتَتِرُ مِنْ بَوْلِهِ، وَكَانَ الآخَرُ يَمْشِي بِالنَّمِيمَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِجَرِيدَةٍ فَكَسَرَهَا كِسْرَتَيْنِ، فَوَضَعَ عَلَى كُلِّ قَبْرٍ مِنْهُمَا كِسْرَةً‏.‏ فَقِيلَ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لِمَ فَعَلْتَ هَذَا قَالَ ‏"‏ لَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يُخَفَّفَ عَنْهُمَا مَا لَمْ تَيْبَسَا أَوْ إِلَى أَنْ يَيْبَسَا ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Once the Prophet, while passing through one of the graveyards of Medina or Mecca heard the voices of two persons who were being tortured in their graves. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "These two persons are being tortured not for a major sin (to avoid)." The Prophet (ﷺ) then added, "Yes! (they are being tortured for a major sin). Indeed, one of them never saved himself from being soiled with his urine while the other used to go about with calumnies (to make enmity between friends). The Prophet (ﷺ) then asked for a green leaf of a date-palm tree, broke it into two pieces and put one on each grave. On being asked why he had done so, he replied, "I hope that their torture might be lessened, till these get dried."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 82; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 215

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي غَسْلِ الْبَوْلِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: What is said regarding washing out urine
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِصَاحِبِ الْقَبْرِ: «كَانَ لاَ يَسْتَتِرُ مِنْ بَوْلِهِ». وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ سِوَى بَوْلِ النَّاسِ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: And the Prophet ﷺ remarked about the person in the grave that he never saved himself from being soiled with his urine. And the Prophet ﷺ mentioned only the urine of human beings. ​​

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي رَوْحُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا تَبَرَّزَ لِحَاجَتِهِ أَتَيْتُهُ بِمَاءٍ فَيَغْسِلُ بِهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) went to answer the call of nature, I used to bring water with which he used to clean his private parts.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 83; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 216

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter:

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَازِمٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، قَالَ مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقَبْرَيْنِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِنَّهُمَا لَيُعَذَّبَانِ، وَمَا يُعَذَّبَانِ فِي كَبِيرٍ أَمَّا أَحَدُهُمَا فَكَانَ لاَ يَسْتَتِرُ مِنَ الْبَوْلِ، وَأَمَّا الآخَرُ فَكَانَ يَمْشِي بِالنَّمِيمَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ جَرِيدَةً رَطْبَةً، فَشَقَّهَا نِصْفَيْنِ، فَغَرَزَ فِي كُلِّ قَبْرٍ وَاحِدَةً‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لِمَ فَعَلْتَ هَذَا قَالَ ‏"‏ لَعَلَّهُ يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمَا مَا لَمْ يَيْبَسَا ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى وَحَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُجَاهِدًا مِثْلَهُ ‏"‏ يَسْتَتِرُ مِنْ بَوْلِهِ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) once passed by two graves and said, "These two persons are being tortured not for a major sin (to avoid). One of them never saved himself from being soiled with his urine, while the other used to go about with calumnies (to make enmity between friends)." The Prophet (ﷺ) then took a green leaf of a date-palm tree, split it into (pieces) and fixed one on each grave. They said, "O Allah's Apostle! Why have you done so?" He replied, "I hope that their punishment might be lessened till these (the pieces of the leaf) become dry." (See the footnote of Hadith 215).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 84; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 217

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب تَرْكِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّاسِ الأَعْرَابِيَّ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنْ بَوْلِهِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The Prophet (saw) and the people left the bedouin undisturbed till he finished urinating in the mosque

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى أَعْرَابِيًّا يَبُولُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: دَعُوهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ دَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَصَبَّهُ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a Bedouin making water in the mosque and told the people not to disturb him. When he finished, the Prophet (ﷺ) asked for some water and poured it over (the urine).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 85; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 218

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب صَبِّ الْمَاءِ عَلَى الْبَوْلِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The pouring of water over the urine in the mosque

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ، قَالَ قَامَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَبَالَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَتَنَاوَلَهُ النَّاسُ، فَقَالَ لَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: دَعُوهُ وَهَرِيقُوا عَلَى بَوْلِهِ سَجْلاً مِنْ مَاءٍ، أَوْ ذَنُوبًا مِنْ مَاءٍ، فَإِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُمْ مُيَسِّرِينَ، وَلَمْ تُبْعَثُوا مُعَسِّرِينَ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: A Bedouin stood up and started making water in the mosque. The people caught him but the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered them to leave him and to pour a bucket or a tumbler of water over the place where he had passed the urine. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "You have been sent to make things easy and not to make them difficult."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 86; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 219

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) said as above (219).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 87; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 220

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب يُهَرِيقُ الْمَاءَ عَلَى الْبَوْلِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: The spilling of water over the place where there is urine
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَبَالَ فِي طَائِفَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَزَجَرَهُ النَّاسُ، فَنَهَاهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَلَمَّا قَضَى بَوْلَهُ أَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذَنُوبٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ، فَأُهْرِيقَ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: Narrated Anas bin Malik: A Bedouin came and passed urine in one corner of the mosque. The people shouted at him but the Prophet stopped them till he finished urinating. The Prophet ordered them to spill a bucket of water over that place and they did so.

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب بَوْلِ الصِّبْيَانِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The urine of children

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِصَبِيٍّ، فَبَالَ عَلَى ثَوْبِهِ،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَأَتْبَعَهُ إِيَّاهُ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: (the mother of faithful believers) A child was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and it urinated on the garment of the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for water and poured it over the soiled place.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 88; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 222

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ ، عَنْ أُمِّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتِ مِحْصَنٍ ، أَنَّهَا أَتَتْ بِابْنٍ لَهَا صَغِيرٍ، لَمْ يَأْكُلِ الطَّعَامَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَأَجْلَسَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حِجْرِهِ، فَبَالَ عَلَى ثَوْبِهِ،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَنَضَحَهُ وَلَمْ يَغْسِلْهُ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I brought my young son, who had not started eating (ordinary food) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who took him and made him sit in his lap. The child urinated on the garment of the Prophet, so he asked for water and poured it over the soiled (area) and did not wash it.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 89; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 223

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الْبَوْلِ قَائِمًا وَقَاعِدًا
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To pass urine while standing and sitting

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ، قَالَ أَتَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُبَاطَةَ قَوْمٍ فَبَالَ قَائِمًا،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: ثُمَّ دَعَا بِمَاءٍ، فَجِئْتُهُ بِمَاءٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Once the Prophet (ﷺ) went to the dumps of some people and passed urine while standing. He then asked for water and so I brought it to him and he performed ablution.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 90; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 224

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الْبَوْلِ عِنْدَ صَاحِبِهِ وَالتَّسَتُّرِ بِالْحَائِطِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To urinate beside one's companion while screened by a wall

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ، قَالَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: رَأَيْتُنِي أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم نَتَمَاشَى، فَأَتَى سُبَاطَةَ قَوْمٍ خَلْفَ حَائِطٍ، فَقَامَ كَمَا يَقُومُ أَحَدُكُمْ فَبَالَ، فَانْتَبَذْتُ مِنْهُ، فَأَشَارَ إِلَىَّ فَجِئْتُهُ، فَقُمْتُ عِنْدَ عَقِبِهِ حَتَّى فَرَغَ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) and I walked till we reached the dumps of some people. He stood, as any one of you stands, behind a wall and urinated. I went away, but he beckoned me to come. So I approached him and stood near his back till he finished.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 91; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 225

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الْبَوْلِ عِنْدَ سُبَاطَةِ قَوْمٍ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To urinate near the dumps of some people

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ ، قَالَ كَانَ أَبُو مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيُّ يُشَدِّدُ فِي الْبَوْلِ وَيَقُولُ إِنَّ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ كَانَ إِذَا أَصَابَ ثَوْبَ أَحَدِهِمْ قَرَضَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ لَيْتَهُ أَمْسَكَ،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَتَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُبَاطَةَ قَوْمٍ فَبَالَ قَائِمًا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari used to lay great stress on the question of urination and he used to say, "If anyone from Bani Israel happened to soil his clothes with urine, he used to cut that portion away." Hearing that, Hudhaifa said to Abu Wail, "I wish he (Abu Musa) didn't (lay great stress on that matter)." Hudhaifa added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to the dumps of some people and urinated while standing."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 92; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 226

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب غَسْلِ الدَّمِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The washing out of blood

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي فَاطِمَةُ ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ ، قَالَتْ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ أَرَأَيْتَ إِحْدَانَا تَحِيضُ فِي الثَّوْبِ كَيْفَ تَصْنَعُ قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: تَحُتُّهُ، ثُمَّ تَقْرُصُهُ بِالْمَاءِ، وَتَنْضَحُهُ وَتُصَلِّي فِيهِ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: A woman came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "If anyone of us gets menses in her clothes then what should she do?" He replied, "She should (take hold of the soiled place), rub it and put it in the water and rub it in order to remove the traces of blood and then pour water over it. Then she can pray in it."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 93; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 227

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ جَاءَتْ فَاطِمَةُ ابْنَةُ أَبِي حُبَيْشٍ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي امْرَأَةٌ أُسْتَحَاضُ فَلاَ أَطْهُرُ، أَفَأَدَعُ الصَّلاَةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: لاَ، إِنَّمَا ذَلِكِ عِرْقٌ، وَلَيْسَ بِحَيْضٍ، فَإِذَا أَقْبَلَتْ حَيْضَتُكِ فَدَعِي الصَّلاَةَ، وَإِذَا أَدْبَرَتْ فَاغْسِلِي عَنْكِ الدَّمَ ثُمَّ صَلِّي ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ أَبِي ‏"‏ ثُمَّ تَوَضَّئِي لِكُلِّ صَلاَةٍ، حَتَّى يَجِيءَ ذَلِكَ الْوَقْتُ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Fatima bint Abi Hubaish came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I get persistent bleeding from the uterus and do not become clean. Shall I give up my prayers?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "No, because it is from a blood vessel and not the menses. So when your real menses begins give up your prayers and when it has finished wash off the blood (take a bath) and offer your prayers." Hisham (the sub narrator) narrated that his father had also said, (the Prophet (ﷺ) told her): "Perform ablution for every prayer till the time of the next period comes."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 94; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 228

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب غَسْلِ الْمَنِيِّ وَفَرْكِهِ وَغَسْلِ مَا يُصِيبُ مِنَ الْمَرْأَةِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The washing out of semen with water and rubbing it off (when it is dry) and the washing out of what comes out of women (i.e., discharge)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ الْجَزَرِيُّ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغْسِلُ الْجَنَابَةَ مِنْ ثَوْبِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَيَخْرُجُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ، وَإِنَّ بُقَعَ الْمَاءِ فِي ثَوْبِهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I used to wash the traces of Janaba (semen) from the clothes of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he used to go for prayers while traces of water were still on it (water spots were still visible).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 95; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 229

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ عَنِ الْمَنِيِّ، يُصِيبُ الثَّوْبَ فَقَالَتْ كُنْتُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَغْسِلُهُ مِنْ ثَوْبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَيَخْرُجُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ وَأَثَرُ الْغَسْلِ فِي ثَوْبِهِ بُقَعُ الْمَاءِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I asked `Aisha about the clothes soiled with semen. She replied, "I used to wash it off the clothes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he would go for the prayer while water spots were still visible. "
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 96; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 230

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب إِذَا غَسَلَ الْجَنَابَةَ أَوْ غَيْرَهَا فَلَمْ يَذْهَبْ أَثَرُهُ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: If the (traces of) Janaba (semen) or other spots are not removed completely on washing

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ فِي الثَّوْبِ تُصِيبُهُ الْجَنَابَةُ قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ كُنْتُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَغْسِلُهُ مِنْ ثَوْبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ وَأَثَرُ الْغَسْلِ فِيهِ بُقَعُ الْمَاءِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I heard Sulaiman bin Yasar talking about the clothes soiled with semen. He said that `Aisha had said, "I used to wash it off the clothes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he would go for the prayers while water spots were still visible on them.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 97; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 231

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ خَالِدٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: تَغْسِلُ الْمَنِيَّ مِنْ ثَوْبِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ أَرَاهُ فِيهِ بُقْعَةً أَوْ بُقَعًا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I used to wash the semen off the clothes of the Prophet (ﷺ) and even then I used to notice one or more spots on them.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 98; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 232

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب أَبْوَالِ الإِبِلِ وَالدَّوَابِّ وَالْغَنَمِ وَمَرَابِضِهَا
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: (What is said) about the urine of camels, sheep and other animals and about their folds
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَصَلَّى أَبُو مُوسَى فِي دَارِ الْبَرِيدِ وَالسِّرْقِينِ وَالْبَرِّيَّةُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ فَقَالَ هَاهُنَا وَثَمَّ سَوَاءٌ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: Abu Musa offered prayer at Dar-il-Barid (post office) and there was animal dung in it though a vast strip of land was near it. Abu Musa said: Both these places are similar (for offering of the prayers). ​​

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ قَدِمَ أُنَاسٌ مِنْ عُكْلٍ أَوْ عُرَيْنَةَ، فَاجْتَوَوُا الْمَدِينَةَ،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَأَمَرَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِلِقَاحٍ، وَأَنْ يَشْرَبُوا مِنْ أَبْوَالِهَا وَأَلْبَانِهَا، فَانْطَلَقُوا، فَلَمَّا صَحُّوا قَتَلُوا رَاعِيَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاسْتَاقُوا النَّعَمَ، فَجَاءَ الْخَبَرُ فِي أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ، فَبَعَثَ فِي آثَارِهِمْ، فَلَمَّا ارْتَفَعَ النَّهَارُ جِيءَ بِهِمْ، فَأَمَرَ فَقَطَعَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَرْجُلَهُمْ، وَسُمِرَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ، وَأُلْقُوا فِي الْحَرَّةِ يَسْتَسْقُونَ فَلاَ يُسْقَوْنَ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو قِلاَبَةَ فَهَؤُلاَءِ سَرَقُوا وَقَتَلُوا وَكَفَرُوا بَعْدَ إِيمَانِهِمْ، وَحَارَبُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Anas said, "Some people of `Ukl or `Uraina tribe came to Medina and its climate did not suit them. So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered them to go to the herd of (Milch) camels and to drink their milk and urine (as a medicine). So they went as directed and after they became healthy, they killed the shepherd of the Prophet and drove away all the camels. The news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) early in the morning and he sent (men) in their pursuit and they were captured and brought at noon. He then ordered to cut their hands and feet (and it was done), and their eyes were branded with heated pieces of iron, They were put in 'Al-Harra' and when they asked for water, no water was given to them." Abu Qilaba said, "Those people committed theft and murder, became infidels after embracing Islam and fought against Allah and His Apostle ."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 99; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 234

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو التَّيَّاحِ، يَزِيدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يُصَلِّي قَبْلَ أَنْ يُبْنَى الْمَسْجِدُ فِي مَرَابِضِ الْغَنَمِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Prior to the construction of the mosque, the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the prayers at sheep-folds.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 100; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 235

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَا يَقَعُ مِنَ النَّجَاسَاتِ فِي السَّمْنِ وَالْمَاءِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: An-Najasat (impure and filthy things) which fall in cooking butter (ghee - which is obtained by evaporating moisture from butter) and water
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَقَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ لاَ بَأْسَ بِالْمَاءِ مَا لَمْ يُغَيِّرْهُ طَعْمٌ أَوْ رِيحٌ أَوْ لَوْنٌ. وَقَالَ حَمَّادٌ لاَ بَأْسَ بِرِيشِ الْمَيْتَةِ. وَقَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ فِي عِظَامِ الْمَوْتَى نَحْوَ الْفِيلِ وَغَيْرِهِ أَدْرَكْتُ نَاسًا مِنْ سَلَفِ الْعُلَمَاءِ يَمْتَشِطُونَ بِهَا، وَيَدَّهِنُونَ فِيهَا، لاَ يَرَوْنَ بِهِ بَأْسًا. وَقَالَ ابْنُ سِيرِينَ وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ وَلاَ بَأْسَ بِتِجَارَةِ الْعَاجِ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: Az-Zuhri said, “There is no harm in using water if its taste, odour, or colour is not changed.” Hammad said, “There is no harm if the feathers of dead birds fell in it.” About the bones of dead animals like an elephant, Az-Zuhri said, “I met some of the old learned religious men who were using them (bones) as combs and as containers for oiling, etc., and they found no harm in that.” Ibn Sirin and Ibrahim said, “There is no harm in the trade of ivory.”

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ عَنْ فَأْرَةٍ سَقَطَتْ فِي سَمْنٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَلْقُوهَا وَمَا حَوْلَهَا فَاطْرَحُوهُ‏.‏ وَكُلُوا سَمْنَكُمْ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked regarding ghee (cooking butter) in which a mouse had fallen. He said, "Take out the mouse and throw away the ghee around it and use the rest."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 101; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 236

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ عَنْ فَأْرَةٍ سَقَطَتْ فِي سَمْنٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: خُذُوهَا وَمَا حَوْلَهَا فَاطْرَحُوهُ ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏‏.‏ قَالَ مَعْنٌ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ مَا لاَ أُحْصِيهِ يَقُولُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked regarding ghee in which a mouse had fallen. He said, "Take out the mouse and throw away the ghee around it (and use the rest.)"
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 102; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 237

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: كُلُّ كَلْمٍ يُكْلَمُهُ الْمُسْلِمُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ يَكُونُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كَهَيْئَتِهَا إِذْ طُعِنَتْ، تَفَجَّرُ دَمًا، اللَّوْنُ لَوْنُ الدَّمِ، وَالْعَرْفُ عَرْفُ الْمِسْكِ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A wound which a Muslim receives in Allah's cause will appear on the Day of Resurrection as it was at the time of infliction; blood will be flowing from the wound and its color will be that of the blood but will smell like musk."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 103; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 238

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الْبَوْلِ فِي الْمَاءِ الدَّائِمِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Urinating in stagnant water

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ هُرْمُزَ الأَعْرَجَ ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: نَحْنُ الآخِرُونَ السَّابِقُونَ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "We (Muslims) are the last (people to come in the world) but (will be) the foremost (on the Day of Resurrection)."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 104; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 239

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: وَبِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: لاَ يَبُولَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الْمَاءِ الدَّائِمِ الَّذِي لاَ يَجْرِي، ثُمَّ يَغْتَسِلُ فِيهِ ‏"
Hadith_List.Narrator_English: The same narrator said that the Prophet (ﷺ) had said:
Hadith_List.Matn_English: "You should not pass urine in stagnant water which is not flowing then (you may need to) wash in it."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 105; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 240

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب إِذَا أُلْقِيَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الْمُصَلِّي قَذَرٌ أَوْ جِيفَةٌ لَمْ تَفْسُدْ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَتُهُ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: If a dead body or a polluted thing is put on the back of a person offering Salat (prayer), his Salat will not be annulled (rejected by Allah)
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ إِذَا رَأَى فِي ثَوْبِهِ دَمًا وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي وَضَعَهُ وَمَضَى فِي صَلاَتِهِ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: In prayer, Ibn ‘Umar used to take off his clothes whenever he saw blood on them and used to continue his prayer. Ibn Al-Musaiyyab and Ash-Sha‘bi said, “Whenever a person offers his Salat (prayers) while wearing clothes stained with blood or Janaba or offers Salat facing in a direction other than the Qiblah (unintentionally) or with Tayammum and finds water before the time of that Salat is over, he does not have to repeat his Salat in any of the above-mentioned cases.” ​​

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ بَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَاجِدٌ ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُرَيْحُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي عِنْدَ الْبَيْتِ، وَأَبُو جَهْلٍ وَأَصْحَابٌ لَهُ جُلُوسٌ، إِذْ قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَيُّكُمْ يَجِيءُ بِسَلَى جَزُورِ بَنِي فُلاَنٍ فَيَضَعُهُ عَلَى ظَهْرِ مُحَمَّدٍ إِذَا سَجَدَ فَانْبَعَثَ أَشْقَى الْقَوْمِ فَجَاءَ بِهِ، فَنَظَرَ حَتَّى إِذَا سَجَدَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَضَعَهُ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ وَأَنَا أَنْظُرُ، لاَ أُغَيِّرُ شَيْئًا، لَوْ كَانَ لِي مَنْعَةٌ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَعَلُوا يَضْحَكُونَ وَيُحِيلُ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَاجِدٌ لاَ يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ، حَتَّى جَاءَتْهُ فَاطِمَةُ، فَطَرَحَتْ عَنْ ظَهْرِهِ، فَرَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْكَ بِقُرَيْشٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ، فَشَقَّ عَلَيْهِمْ إِذْ دَعَا عَلَيْهِمْ ـ قَالَ وَكَانُوا يُرَوْنَ أَنَّ الدَّعْوَةَ فِي ذَلِكَ الْبَلَدِ مُسْتَجَابَةٌ ـ ثُمَّ سَمَّى ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْكَ بِأَبِي جَهْلٍ، وَعَلَيْكَ بِعُتْبَةَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، وَشَيْبَةَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، وَالْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، وَأُمَيَّةَ بْنِ خَلَفٍ، وَعُقْبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُعَيْطٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَعَدَّ السَّابِعَ فَلَمْ يَحْفَظْهُ قَالَ فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ الَّذِينَ عَدَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَرْعَى فِي الْقَلِيبِ قَلِيبِ بَدْرٍ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was prostrating (as stated below). Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud: Once the Prophet (ﷺ) was offering prayers at the Ka`ba. Abu Jahl was sitting with some of his companions. One of them said to the others, "Who amongst you will bring the Abdominal contents (intestines, etc.) of a camel of Bani so and so and put it on the back of Muhammad, when he prostrates?" The most unfortunate of them got up and brought it. He waited till the Prophet (ﷺ) prostrated and then placed it on his back between his shoulders. I was watching but could not do any thing. I wish I had some people with me to hold out against them. They started laughing and falling on one another. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in prostration and he did not lift his head up till Fatima (Prophet's daughter) came and threw that (camel's Abdominal contents) away from his back. He raised his head and said thrice, "O Allah! Punish Quraish." So it was hard for Abu Jahl and his companions when the Prophet invoked Allah against them as they had a conviction that the prayers and invocations were accepted in this city (Mecca). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Punish Abu Jahl, `Utba bin Rabi`a, Shaiba bin Rabi`a, Al-Walid bin `Utba, Umaiya bin Khalaf, and `Uqba bin Al Mu'it [??] (and he mentioned the seventh whose name I cannot recall). By Allah in Whose Hands my life is, I saw the dead bodies of those persons who were counted by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the Qalib (one of the wells) of Badr.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 106; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 241

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الْبُزَاقِ وَالْمُخَاطِ وَنَحْوِهِ فِي الثَّوْبِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Spitting or blowing out the nose or doing similar action in one's own garment
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: قَالَ عُرْوَةُ عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ وَمَرْوَانَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ زَمَنَ حُدَيْبِيَةَ فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ. وَمَا تَنَخَّمَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نُخَامَةً إِلاَّ وَقَعَتْ فِي كَفِّ رَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ فَدَلَكَ بِهَا وَجْهَهُ وَجِلْدَهُ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: Narrated Miswar bin Makhrama and Marwan: Allah’s Messenger ﷺ set out at the time of Al-Hudaibiya (treaty), and mentioned the rest of Hadith and when Allah’s Messenger ﷺ spitted, the spittle would fall in the hand of one of them (the Prophet’s Companions) who would rub it on his face and skin. ​​

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: بَزَقَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ثَوْبِهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: طَوَّلَهُ ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدٌ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) once spat in his clothes.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 107; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 242

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب لاَ يَجُوزُ الْوُضُوءُ بِالنَّبِيذِ وَلاَ الْمُسْكِرِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: It is unlawful to perform ablution with Nabidh (water in which dates or grapes etc, are soaked and is not yet fermented) or with any other intoxicant
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَكَرِهَهُ الْحَسَنُ وَأَبُو الْعَالِيَةِ. وَقَالَ عَطَاءٌ التَّيَمُّمُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنَ الْوُضُوءِ بِالنَّبِيذِ وَاللَّبَنِ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: Hasan and Abul-‘Aliya disliked it. ‘Ata’ said: I prefer to do Tayammum instead of doing ablution with milk or Nabidh. ​​

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: كُلُّ شَرَابٍ أَسْكَرَ فَهُوَ حَرَامٌ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "All drinks that produce intoxication are Haram (forbidden to drink).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 108; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 243

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب غَسْلِ الْمَرْأَةِ أَبَاهَا الدَّمَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Washing blood by a women off her father's face
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَقَالَ أَبُو الْعَالِيَةِ امْسَحُوا عَلَى رِجْلِي فَإِنَّهَا مَرِيضَةٌ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: Abul-‘Aliya said: Rub my leg as it is aching.

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ ، سَمِعَ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ ،، وَسَأَلَهُ النَّاسُ، وَمَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ أَحَدٌ بِأَىِّ شَىْءٍ دُووِيَ جُرْحُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ مَا بَقِيَ أَحَدٌ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي، كَانَ عَلِيٌّ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَجِيءُ بِتُرْسِهِ فِيهِ مَاءٌ، وَفَاطِمَةُ تَغْسِلُ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ الدَّمَ، فَأُخِذَ حَصِيرٌ فَأُحْرِقَ فَحُشِيَ بِهِ جُرْحُهُ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi, was asked by the people, "With what was the wound of the Prophet (ﷺ) treated? Sahl replied, "None remains among the people living who knows that better than I. `Ali [??] used to bring water in his shield and Fatima used to wash the blood off his face. Then straw mat was burnt and the wound was filled with it."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 109; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 244

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب السِّوَاكِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Siwak (to clean the teeth with Siwak which is a tooth-brush in the form of a pencil from the roots of the Arak tree
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ بِتُّ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَاسْتَنَّ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: Ibn ‘Abbas said, “Once I passed the night with the Prophet ﷺ and saw him cleaning his teeth (with Siwak).” ​​

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ غَيْلاَنَ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَجَدْتُهُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَسْتَنُّ بِسِوَاكٍ بِيَدِهِ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ أُعْ أُعْ ‏"‏، وَالسِّوَاكُ فِي فِيهِ، كَأَنَّهُ يَتَهَوَّعُ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: My father said, "I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and saw him carrying a Siwak in his hand and cleansing his teeth, saying, 'U' U'," as if he was retching while the Siwak was in his mouth."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 110; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 245

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ يَشُوصُ فَاهُ بِالسِّوَاكِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) got up at night, he used to clean his mouth with Siwak.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 111; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 246

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب دَفْعِ السِّوَاكِ إِلَى الأَكْبَرِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To give Siwak to the oldest person of the group

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: وَقَالَ عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا صَخْرُ بْنُ جُوَيْرِيَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: "‏ أَرَانِي أَتَسَوَّكُ بِسِوَاكٍ، فَجَاءَنِي رَجُلاَنِ أَحَدُهُمَا أَكْبَرُ مِنَ الآخَرِ، فَنَاوَلْتُ السِّوَاكَ الأَصْغَرَ مِنْهُمَا، فَقِيلَ لِي كَبِّرْ‏.‏ فَدَفَعْتُهُ إِلَى الأَكْبَرِ مِنْهُمَا ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ اخْتَصَرَهُ نُعَيْمٌ عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I dreamt that I was cleaning my teeth with a Siwak and two persons came to me. One of them was older than the other and I gave the Siwak to the younger. I was told that I should give it to the older and so I did."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 112; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 246

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب فَضْلِ مَنْ بَاتَ عَلَى الْوُضُوءِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The superiority of a person who sleeps with ablution.

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا أَتَيْتَ مَضْجَعَكَ فَتَوَضَّأْ وُضُوءَكَ لِلصَّلاَةِ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجِعْ عَلَى شِقِّكَ الأَيْمَنِ، ثُمَّ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، اللَّهُمَّ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ‏.‏ فَإِنْ مُتَّ مِنْ لَيْلَتِكَ فَأَنْتَ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ، وَاجْعَلْهُنَّ آخِرَ مَا تَتَكَلَّمُ بِهِ ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَدَّدْتُهَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا بَلَغْتُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَرَسُولِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ، وَنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Whenever you go to bed perform ablution like that for the prayer, lie or your right side and say, "Allahumma aslamtu wajhi ilaika, wa fauwadtu `Amri ilaika, wa alja'tu Zahri ilaika raghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika. La Malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Allahumma amantu bikitabika-l-ladhi anzalta wa bina-biyika-l ladhi arsalta" (O Allah! I surrender to You and entrust all my affairs to You and depend upon You for Your Blessings both with hope and fear of You. There is no fleeing from You, and there is no place of protection and safety except with You O Allah! I believe in Your Book (the Qur'an) which You have revealed and in Your Prophet (Muhammad) whom You have sent). Then if you die on that very night, you will die with faith (i.e. or the religion of Islam). Let the aforesaid words be your last utterance (before sleep)." I repeated it before the Prophet (ﷺ) and when I reached "Allahumma amantu bikitabika-l-ladhi anzalta (O Allah I believe in Your Book which You have revealed)." I said, "Wa-rasulika (and your Apostle)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No, (but say): 'Wanabiyika-l-ladhi arsalta (Your Prophet whom You have sent), instead."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 4, Hadith 113; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 4, Hadith 247

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الْوُضُوءِ قَبْلَ الْغُسْلِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The performance of ablution before taking a bath

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا اغْتَسَلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ بَدَأَ فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ يَتَوَضَّأُ كَمَا يَتَوَضَّأُ لِلصَّلاَةِ، ثُمَّ يُدْخِلُ أَصَابِعَهُ فِي الْمَاءِ، فَيُخَلِّلُ بِهَا أُصُولَ شَعَرِهِ ثُمَّ يَصُبُّ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثَلاَثَ غُرَفٍ بِيَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ يُفِيضُ الْمَاءَ عَلَى جِلْدِهِ كُلِّهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) took a bath after Janaba he started by washing his hands and then performed ablution like that for the prayer. After that he would put his fingers in water and move the roots of his hair with them, and then pour three handfuls of water over his head and then pour water all over his body.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 1; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 248

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: تَوَضَّأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وُضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلاَةِ غَيْرَ رِجْلَيْهِ، وَغَسَلَ فَرْجَهُ، وَمَا أَصَابَهُ مِنَ الأَذَى، ثُمَّ أَفَاضَ عَلَيْهِ الْمَاءَ، ثُمَّ نَحَّى رِجْلَيْهِ فَغَسَلَهُمَا، هَذِهِ غُسْلُهُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: (the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed ablution like that for the prayer but did not wash his feet. He washed off the discharge from his private parts and then poured water over his body. He withdrew his feet from that place (the place where he took the bath) and then washed them. And that was his way of taking the bath of Janaba.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 2; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 249

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب غُسْلِ الرَّجُلِ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Taking a bath by a man along with his wife

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ مِنْ قَدَحٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ الْفَرَقُ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) and I used to take a bath from a single pot called 'Faraq'.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 3; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 250

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الْغُسْلِ بِالصَّاعِ وَنَحْوِهِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Taking a bath with a Sa' of water or so (One Sa' = 3 kilograms approx.)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ حَفْصٍ ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ ، يَقُولُ دَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَأَخُو، عَائِشَةَ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَسَأَلَهَا أَخُوهَا عَنْ غُسْلِ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَدَعَتْ بِإِنَاءٍ نَحْوًا مِنْ صَاعٍ، فَاغْتَسَلَتْ وَأَفَاضَتْ عَلَى رَأْسِهَا، وَبَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهَا حِجَابٌ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ وَبَهْزٌ وَالْجُدِّيُّ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ قَدْرِ صَاعٍ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: `Aisha's brother and I went to `Aisha and he asked her about the bath of the Prophet. She brought a pot containing about a Sa` of water and took a bath and poured it over her head and at that time there was a screen between her and us.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 4; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 251

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ عِنْدَ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ هُوَ وَأَبُوهُ، وَعِنْدَهُ قَوْمٌ فَسَأَلُوهُ عَنِ الْغُسْلِ،‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَكْفِيكَ صَاعٌ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مَا يَكْفِينِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ جَابِرٌ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: كَانَ يَكْفِي مَنْ هُوَ أَوْفَى مِنْكَ شَعَرًا، وَخَيْرٌ مِنْكَ
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ، ثُمَّ أَمَّنَا فِي ثَوْبٍ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: While I and my father were with Jabir bin `Abdullah, some people asked him about taking a bath. He replied, "A Sa` of water is sufficient for you." A man said, "A Sa` is not sufficient for me." Jabir said, "A Sa` was sufficient for one who had more hair than you and was better than you (meaning the Prophet)." And then Jabir (put on) his garment and led the prayer.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 5; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 252
