Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَيْمُونَةَ كَانَا
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَغْتَسِلاَنِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ كَانَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ يَقُولُ أَخِيرًا عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، وَالصَّحِيحُ مَا رَوَى أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) and Maimuna used to take a bath from a single pot.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 6; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 253

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَنْ أَفَاضَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثَلاَثًا
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Pouring water thrice on one's head

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ صُرَدٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي جُبَيْرُ بْنُ مُطْعِمٍ ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَمَّا أَنَا فَأُفِيضُ عَلَى رَأْسِي ثَلاَثًا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَشَارَ بِيَدَيْهِ كِلْتَيْهِمَا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "As for me, I pour water three times on my head." And he pointed with both his hands.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 7; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 254

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مِخْوَلِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يُفْرِغُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثَلاَثًا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pour water three times on his head.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 8; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 255

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَامٍ ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي جَابِرٌ أَتَانِي ابْنُ عَمِّكَ يُعَرِّضُ بِالْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ابْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ قَالَ كَيْفَ الْغُسْلُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ فَقُلْتُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَأْخُذُ ثَلاَثَةَ أَكُفٍّ وَيُفِيضُهَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ، ثُمَّ يُفِيضُ عَلَى سَائِرِ جَسَدِهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لِي الْحَسَنُ إِنِّي رَجُلٌ كَثِيرُ الشَّعَرِ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكْثَرَ مِنْكَ شَعَرًا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Jabir bin `Abdullah said to me, "Your cousin (Hasan bin Muhammad bin Al-Hanafiya) came to me and asked about the bath of Janaba. I replied, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) uses to take three handfuls of water, pour them on his head and then pour more water over his body.' Al-Hasan said to me, 'I am a hairy man.' I replied, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) had more hair than you'. "
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 9; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 256

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الْغُسْلِ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To wash the body (parts) once only

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، قَالَ قَالَتْ مَيْمُونَةُ وَضَعْتُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَاءً لِلْغُسْلِ،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ أَفْرَغَ عَلَى شِمَالِهِ فَغَسَلَ مَذَاكِيرَهُ، ثُمَّ مَسَحَ يَدَهُ بِالأَرْضِ، ثُمَّ مَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ وَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أَفَاضَ عَلَى جَسَدِهِ، ثُمَّ تَحَوَّلَ مِنْ مَكَانِهِ فَغَسَلَ قَدَمَيْهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I placed water for the bath of the Prophet. He washed his hands twice or thrice and then poured water on his left hand and washed his private parts. He rubbed his hands over the earth (and cleaned them), rinsed his mouth, washed his nose by putting water in it and blowing it out, washed his face and both forearms and then poured water over his body. Then he withdrew from that place and washed his feet.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 10; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 257

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَنْ بَدَأَ بِالْحِلاَبِ أَوِ الطِّيبِ عِنْدَ الْغُسْلِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Starting one's bath by scenting oneself with Hilab or some other scent

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا اغْتَسَلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: دَعَا بِشَىْءٍ نَحْوَ الْحِلاَبِ، فَأَخَذَ بِكَفِّهِ، فَبَدَأَ بِشِقِّ رَأْسِهِ الأَيْمَنِ ثُمَّ الأَيْسَرِ، فَقَالَ بِهِمَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) took the bath of Janaba (sexual relation or wet dream) he asked for the Hilab or some other scent. He used to take it in his hand, rub it first over the right side of his head and then over the left and then rub the middle of his head with both hands.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 11; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 258

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الْمَضْمَضَةِ وَالاِسْتِنْشَاقِ فِي الْجَنَابَةِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To rinse the mouth and to clean the nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out while taking the bath of Janaba

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمٌ ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنَا مَيْمُونَةُ ، قَالَتْ صَبَبْتُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غُسْلاً،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَأَفْرَغَ بِيَمِينِهِ عَلَى يَسَارِهِ فَغَسَلَهُمَا، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ فَرْجَهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ بِيَدِهِ الأَرْضَ فَمَسَحَهَا بِالتُّرَابِ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَهَا، ثُمَّ تَمَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ، وَأَفَاضَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ، ثُمَّ تَنَحَّى فَغَسَلَ قَدَمَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِمِنْدِيلٍ، فَلَمْ يَنْفُضْ بِهَا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I placed water for the bath of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he poured water with his right hand on his left and washed them. Then he washed his private parts and rubbed his hands on the ground, washed them with water, rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and blowing it out, washed his face and poured water on his head. He withdrew from that place and washed his feet. A piece of cloth (towel) was given to him but he did not use it.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 12; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 259

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَسْحِ الْيَدِ بِالتُّرَابِ لِيَكُونَ أَنْقَى
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The rubbing of hands with earth in ore to clean them thoroughly

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: اغْتَسَلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ، فَغَسَلَ فَرْجَهُ بِيَدِهِ، ثُمَّ دَلَكَ بِهَا الْحَائِطَ ثُمَّ غَسَلَهَا، ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلاَةِ، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنْ غُسْلِهِ غَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) took the bath of Janaba. (sexual relation or wet dream). He first cleaned his private parts with his hand, and then rubbed it (that hand) on the wall (earth) and washed it. Then he performed ablution like that for the prayer, and after the bath he washed his feet.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 13; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 260

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب هَلْ يُدْخِلُ الْجُنُبُ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَغْسِلَهَا إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَى يَدِهِ قَذَرٌ غَيْرُ الْجَنَابَةِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Can a Junub (a person who has yet to take bath after the sexual act or wet dream) put his hands in a pot (containing water) before washing them if they are not polluted with a dirty thing except Janaba?

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَفْلَحُ ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ تَخْتَلِفُ أَيْدِينَا فِيهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) and I used to take a bath from a single pot of water and our hands used to go in the pot after each other in turn.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 14; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 261

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا اغْتَسَلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ غَسَلَ يَدَهُ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took a bath of Janaba, he washed his hands first.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 15; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 262

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَفْصٍ ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ مِنْ جَنَابَةٍ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ مِثْلَهُ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) and I used to take a bath from a single pot of water after Janaba.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 16; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 263

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَبْرٍ ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ، يَقُولُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ نِسَائِهِ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَغْتَسِلاَنِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: زَادَ مُسْلِمٌ وَوَهْبٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) and one of his wives used to take a bath from a single pot of water. (Shu`ba added to Anas' Statement "After the Janaba").
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 17; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 264

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب تَفْرِيقِ الْغُسْلِ وَالْوُضُوءِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Interval during ablution or bath
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَيُذْكَرُ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّهُ غَسَلَ قَدَمَيْهِ بَعْدَ مَا جَفَّ وَضُوءُهُ.

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، قَالَ قَالَتْ مَيْمُونَةُ وَضَعْتُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَاءً يَغْتَسِلُ بِهِ،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَأَفْرَغَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ، فَغَسَلَهُمَا مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ أَفْرَغَ بِيَمِينِهِ عَلَى شِمَالِهِ، فَغَسَلَ مَذَاكِيرَهُ، ثُمَّ دَلَكَ يَدَهُ بِالأَرْضِ، ثُمَّ مَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ غَسَلَ رَأْسَهُ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ أَفْرَغَ عَلَى جَسَدِهِ، ثُمَّ تَنَحَّى مِنْ مَقَامِهِ فَغَسَلَ قَدَمَيْهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I placed water for the bath of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he poured water over his hands and washed them twice or thrice; then he poured water with his right hand over his left and washed his private parts (with his left hand). He rubbed his hand over the earth and rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and blowing it out. After that he washed his face, both fore arms and head thrice and then poured water over his body. He withdrew from that place and washed his feet.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 18; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 265

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَنْ أَفْرَغَ بِيَمِينِهِ عَلَى شِمَالِهِ فِي الْغُسْلِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Pouring water with one's right hand over the left one, during the bath

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ ، قَالَتْ وَضَعْتُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غُسْلاً وَسَتَرْتُهُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: ، فَصَبَّ عَلَى يَدِهِ، فَغَسَلَهَا مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ ـ قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ لاَ أَدْرِي أَذَكَرَ الثَّالِثَةَ أَمْ لاَ ـ ثُمَّ أَفْرَغَ بِيَمِينِهِ عَلَى شِمَالِهِ، فَغَسَلَ فَرْجَهُ، ثُمَّ دَلَكَ يَدَهُ بِالأَرْضِ أَوْ بِالْحَائِطِ، ثُمَّ تَمَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ، وَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ، وَغَسَلَ رَأْسَهُ، ثُمَّ صَبَّ عَلَى جَسَدِهِ، ثُمَّ تَنَحَّى فَغَسَلَ قَدَمَيْهِ، فَنَاوَلْتُهُ خِرْقَةً، فَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ هَكَذَا، وَلَمْ يُرِدْهَا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I placed water for the bath of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and put a screen. He poured water over his hands, and washed them once or twice. (The sub-narrator added that he did not remember if she had said thrice or not). Then he poured water with his right hand over his left one and washed his private parts. He rubbed his hand over the earth or the wall and washed it. He rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and blowing it out. He washed his face, forearms and head. He poured water over his body and then withdrew from that place and washed his feet. I presented him a piece of cloth (towel) and he pointed with his hand (that he does not want it) and did not take it.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 19; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 266

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب إِذَا جَامَعَ ثُمَّ عَادَ، وَمَنْ دَارَ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ فِي غُسْلٍ وَاحِدٍ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Having sexual intercourse and repeating it. And engaging with one's own wives and taking a single bath (after doing so)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ ذَكَرْتُهُ لِعَائِشَةَ فَقَالَتْ يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، كُنْتُ أُطَيِّبُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَيَطُوفُ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ، ثُمَّ يُصْبِحُ مُحْرِمًا يَنْضَخُ طِيبًا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: on the authority of his father that he had asked `Aisha (about the Hadith of Ibn `Umar). She said, "May Allah be Merciful to Abu `Abdur-Rahman. I used to put scent on Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he used to go round his wives, and in the morning he assumed the Ihram, and the fragrance of scent was still coming out from his body."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 20; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 267

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَدُورُ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ فِي السَّاعَةِ الْوَاحِدَةِ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَهُنَّ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَنَسٍ أَوَكَانَ يُطِيقُهُ قَالَ كُنَّا نَتَحَدَّثُ أَنَّهُ أُعْطِيَ قُوَّةَ ثَلاَثِينَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ إِنَّ أَنَسًا حَدَّثَهُمْ تِسْعُ نِسْوَةٍ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Anas bin Malik said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to visit all his wives in a round, during the day and night and they were eleven in number." I asked Anas, "Had the Prophet (ﷺ) the strength for it?" Anas replied, "We used to say that the Prophet (ﷺ) was given the strength of thirty (men)." And Sa`id said on the authority of Qatada that Anas had told him about nine wives only (not eleven).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 21; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 268

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب غَسْلِ الْمَذْىِ وَالْوُضُوءِ مِنْهُ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The washing away of emotional urethral discharge and performing ablution after it

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ، قَالَ كُنْتُ رَجُلاً مَذَّاءً فَأَمَرْتُ رَجُلاً أَنْ يَسْأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِمَكَانِ ابْنَتِهِ فَسَأَلَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: تَوَضَّأْ وَاغْسِلْ ذَكَرَكَ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I used to get emotional urethral discharge frequently. Being the son-in-law of the Prophet (ﷺ) I requested a man to ask him about it. So the man asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about it. The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Perform ablution after washing your organ (penis)."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 22; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 269

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَنْ تَطَيَّبَ ثُمَّ اغْتَسَلَ وَبَقِيَ أَثَرُ الطِّيبِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Whoever scented himself and then took a bath while the effect of scent remained even after bathing

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ فَذَكَرْتُ لَهَا قَوْلَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ مَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أُصْبِحَ، مُحْرِمًا أَنْضَخُ طِيبًا‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَنَا طَيَّبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ طَافَ فِي نِسَائِهِ ثُمَّ أَصْبَحَ مُحْرِمًا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: on the authority of his father that he had asked `Aisha about the saying of Ibn `Umar (i.e. he did not like to be a Muhrim while the smell of scent was still coming from his body). `Aisha said, "I scented Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he went round (had sexual intercourse with) all his wives, and in the morning he was Muhrim (after taking a bath)."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 23; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 270

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَبِيصِ الطِّيبِ فِي مَفْرِقِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ مُحْرِمٌ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: It is as if I am just looking at the glitter of scent in the parting of the Prophet's head hair while he was a Muhrim.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 24; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 271

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب تَخْلِيلِ الشَّعَرِ حَتَّى إِذَا ظَنَّ أَنَّهُ قَدْ أَرْوَى بَشَرَتَهُ أَفَاضَ عَلَيْهِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To rub the hair thoroughly (while taking a bath) till one feels that one has made his skin wet (underneath the hair) and the one pours water over it

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا اغْتَسَلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ غَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ، وَتَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلاَةِ ثُمَّ اغْتَسَلَ، ثُمَّ يُخَلِّلُ بِيَدِهِ شَعَرَهُ، حَتَّى إِذَا ظَنَّ أَنْ قَدْ أَرْوَى بَشَرَتَهُ، أَفَاضَ عَلَيْهِ الْمَاءَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ سَائِرَ جَسَدِهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ نَغْرِفُ مِنْهُ جَمِيعًا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: (on the authority of his father) `Aisha said, "Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took the bath of Janaba, he cleaned his hands and performed ablution like that for prayer and then took a bath and rubbed his hair, till he felt that the whole skin of the head had become wet, then he would pour water thrice and wash the rest of the body." `Aisha further said, "I and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to take a bath from a single water container, from which we took water simultaneously."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 25; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 272

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: بَابُ مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ فِي الْجَنَابَةِ ثُمَّ غَسَلَ سَائِرَ جَسَدِهِ، وَلَمْ يُعِدْ، غَسْلَ مَوَاضِعِ الْوُضُوءِ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Whoever performed the ablution of Janaba and then washed his body but did not wash once again the parts which were washed in ablution

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ مُوسَى ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا الأَعْمَشُ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ ، قَالَتْ وَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَضُوءًا لِجَنَابَةٍ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَأَكْفَأَ بِيَمِينِهِ عَلَى شِمَالِهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ، أَوْ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ فَرْجَهُ، ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ يَدَهُ بِالأَرْضِ ـ أَوِ الْحَائِطِ ـ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ مَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ، وَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَذِرَاعَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أَفَاضَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ الْمَاءَ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ جَسَدَهُ، ثُمَّ تَنَحَّى فَغَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِخِرْقَةٍ، فَلَمْ يُرِدْهَا، فَجَعَلَ يَنْفُضُ بِيَدِهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Water was placed for the ablution of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) after Janaba. He poured water with his right hand over his left twice or thrice and then washed his private parts and rubbed his hand on the earth or on a wall twice or thrice and then rinsed his mouth, washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out and then washed his face and forearms and poured water over his head and washed his body. Then he shifted from that place and washed his feet. I brought a piece of cloth, but he did not take it and removed the traces of water from his body with his hand."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 26; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 273

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب إِذَا ذَكَرَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ أَنَّهُ جُنُبٌ يَخْرُجُ كَمَا هُوَ وَلاَ يَتَيَمَّمُ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: If someone while in the mosque remembers that he is Junub, he should leave (the mosque to take a bath) and should not perform Tayammum

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، قَالَ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ، وَعُدِّلَتِ الصُّفُوفُ قِيَامًا،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا قَامَ فِي مُصَلاَّهُ ذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ جُنُبٌ فَقَالَ لَنَا ‏:‏ ‏"‏ مَكَانَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَاغْتَسَلَ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَيْنَا وَرَأْسُهُ يَقْطُرُ، فَكَبَّرَ فَصَلَّيْنَا مَعَهُ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: تَابَعَهُ عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ الأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Once the call (Iqama) for the prayer was announced and the rows were straightened. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out; and when he stood up at his Musalla, he remembered that he was Junub. Then he ordered us to stay at our places and went to take a bath and then returned with water dropping from his head. He said, "Allahu-Akbar", and we all offered the prayer with him.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 27; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 274

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب نَفْضِ الْيَدَيْنِ مِنَ الْغُسْلِ عَنِ الْجَنَابَةِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The removing of water from one's body with one's hands after taking the bath of Janaba

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو حَمْزَةَ ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الأَعْمَشَ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، قَالَ قَالَتْ مَيْمُونَةُ وَضَعْتُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غُسْلاً، فَسَتَرْتُهُ بِثَوْبٍ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: ، وَصَبَّ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ فَغَسَلَهُمَا، ثُمَّ صَبَّ بِيَمِينِهِ عَلَى شِمَالِهِ، فَغَسَلَ فَرْجَهُ، فَضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ الأَرْضَ فَمَسَحَهَا، ثُمَّ غَسَلَهَا فَمَضْمَضَ، وَاسْتَنْشَقَ، وَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَذِرَاعَيْهِ، ثُمَّ صَبَّ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ، وَأَفَاضَ عَلَى جَسَدِهِ، ثُمَّ تَنَحَّى فَغَسَلَ قَدَمَيْهِ، فَنَاوَلْتُهُ ثَوْبًا فَلَمْ يَأْخُذْهُ، فَانْطَلَقَ وَهْوَ يَنْفُضُ يَدَيْهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I placed water for the bath of the Prophet (ﷺ) and screened him with a garment. He poured water over his hands and washed them. After that he poured water with his right hand over his left and washed his private parts, rubbed his hands with earth and washed them, rinsed his mouth, washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out and then washed his face and forearms. He poured water over his head and body. He then shifted from that place and washed his feet. I gave him a piece of cloth but he did not take it and came out removing the water (from his body) with both his hands.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 28; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 275

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَنْ بَدَأَ بِشِقِّ رَأْسِهِ الأَيْمَنِ فِي الْغُسْلِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Starting from the right side of one's head while taking a bath

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَلاَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ ، عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ كُنَّا
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا أَصَابَتْ إِحْدَانَا جَنَابَةٌ، أَخَذَتْ بِيَدَيْهَا ثَلاَثًا فَوْقَ رَأْسِهَا، ثُمَّ تَأْخُذُ بِيَدِهَا عَلَى شِقِّهَا الأَيْمَنِ، وَبِيَدِهَا الأُخْرَى عَلَى شِقِّهَا الأَيْسَرِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Whenever any one of us was Junub, she poured water over her head thrice with both her hands and then rubbed the right side of her head with one hand and rubbed the left side of the head with the other hand.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 29; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 276

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَنِ اغْتَسَلَ عُرْيَانًا وَحْدَهُ فِي الْخَلْوَةِ، وَمَنْ تَسَتَّرَ فَالتَّسَتُّرُ أَفْضَلُ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Whosoever took a bath alone (in seclusion) completely naked
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَقَالَ بَهْزٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «اللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَنْ يُسْتَحْيَا مِنْهُ مِنَ النَّاسِ».

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: كَانَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ يَغْتَسِلُونَ عُرَاةً، يَنْظُرُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَى بَعْضٍ، وَكَانَ مُوسَى يَغْتَسِلُ وَحْدَهُ، فَقَالُوا وَاللَّهِ مَا يَمْنَعُ مُوسَى أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ مَعَنَا إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ آدَرُ، فَذَهَبَ مَرَّةً يَغْتَسِلُ، فَوَضَعَ ثَوْبَهُ عَلَى حَجَرٍ، فَفَرَّ الْحَجَرُ بِثَوْبِهِ، فَخَرَجَ مُوسَى فِي إِثْرِهِ يَقُولُ ثَوْبِي يَا حَجَرُ‏.‏ حَتَّى نَظَرَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ إِلَى مُوسَى، فَقَالُوا وَاللَّهِ مَا بِمُوسَى مِنْ بَأْسٍ‏.‏ وَأَخَذَ ثَوْبَهُ، فَطَفِقَ بِالْحَجَرِ ضَرْبًا ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ وَاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَنَدَبٌ بِالْحَجَرِ سِتَّةٌ أَوْ سَبْعَةٌ ضَرْبًا بِالْحَجَرِ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The (people of) Bani Israel used to take bath naked (all together) looking at each other. The Prophet (ﷺ) Moses used to take a bath alone. They said, 'By Allah! Nothing prevents Moses from taking a bath with us except that he has a scrotal hernia.' So once Moses went out to take a bath and put his clothes over a stone and then that stone ran away with his clothes. Moses followed that stone saying, "My clothes, O stone! My clothes, O stone! till the people of Bani Israel saw him and said, 'By Allah, Moses has got no defect in his body. Moses took his clothes and began to beat the stone." Abu Huraira added, "By Allah! There are still six or seven marks present on the stone from that excessive beating."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 30; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 277

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: بَيْنَا أَيُّوبُ يَغْتَسِلُ عُرْيَانًا فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِ جَرَادٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، فَجَعَلَ أَيُّوبُ يَحْتَثِي فِي ثَوْبِهِ، فَنَادَاهُ رَبُّهُ يَا أَيُّوبُ، أَلَمْ أَكُنْ أَغْنَيْتُكَ عَمَّا تَرَى قَالَ بَلَى وَعِزَّتِكَ وَلَكِنْ لاَ غِنَى بِي عَنْ بَرَكَتِكَ ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ بَيْنَا أَيُّوبُ يَغْتَسِلُ عُرْيَانًا
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When the Prophet (ﷺ) Job (Aiyub) was taking a bath naked, golden locusts began to fall on him. Job started collecting them in his clothes. His Lord addressed him, 'O Job! Haven't I given you enough so that you are not in need of them.' Job replied, 'Yes!' By Your Honor (power)! But I cannot dispense with Your Blessings.' "
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 31; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 277

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب التَّسَتُّرِ فِي الْغُسْلِ عِنْدَ النَّاسِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To screen oneself from the people while taking a bath

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ ، مَوْلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ أَبَا مُرَّةَ ، مَوْلَى أُمِّ هَانِئٍ بِنْتِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أُمَّ هَانِئٍ بِنْتَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ ، تَقُولُ ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْفَتْحِ، فَوَجَدْتُهُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَغْتَسِلُ وَفَاطِمَةُ تَسْتُرُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ هَذِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَنَا أُمُّ هَانِئٍ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Narrator_English: Narrated Um Hani bint Abi Talib:
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the year of the conquest of Mecca and found him taking a bath while Fatima was screening him. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Who is it?" I replied, "I am Um-Hani."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 32; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 278

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ ، قَالَتْ سَتَرْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَغْتَسِلُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: ، فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ صَبَّ بِيَمِينِهِ عَلَى شِمَالِهِ، فَغَسَلَ فَرْجَهُ، وَمَا أَصَابَهُ، ثُمَّ مَسَحَ بِيَدِهِ عَلَى الْحَائِطِ أَوِ الأَرْضِ، ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلاَةِ، غَيْرَ رِجْلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أَفَاضَ عَلَى جَسَدِهِ الْمَاءَ، ثُمَّ تَنَحَّى فَغَسَلَ قَدَمَيْهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: تَابَعَهُ أَبُو عَوَانَةَ وَابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ فِي السَّتْرِ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I screened the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was taking a bath of Janaba. He washed his hands, poured water from his right hand over his left and washed his private parts. Then he rubbed his hand over a wall or the earth, and performed ablution similar to that for the prayer but did not wash his feet. Then he poured water over his body, shifted from that place, and washed his feet.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 33; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 279

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب إِذَا احْتَلَمَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: If a woman has a wet dream (nocturnal sexual discharge)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ جَاءَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ امْرَأَةُ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَسْتَحْيِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ، هَلْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ مِنْ غُسْلٍ إِذَا هِيَ احْتَلَمَتْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: نَعَمْ إِذَا رَأَتِ الْمَاءَ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: (the mother of the believers) Um Sulaim, the wife of Abu Talha, came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Verily Allah is not shy of (telling you) the truth. Is it necessary for a woman to take a bath after she has a wet dream (nocturnal sexual discharge)?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "Yes, if she notices a discharge."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 34; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 280

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب عَرَقِ الْجُنُبِ وَأَنَّ الْمُسْلِمَ لاَ يَنْجُسُ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: (What is said regarding) the sweat of a Junub. And a Muslim never becomes impure

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرٌ ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَقِيَهُ فِي بَعْضِ طَرِيقِ الْمَدِينَةِ وَهْوَ جُنُبٌ، فَانْخَنَسْتُ مِنْهُ، فَذَهَبَ فَاغْتَسَلَ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ كُنْتَ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ كُنْتُ جُنُبًا، فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أُجَالِسَكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى غَيْرِ طَهَارَةٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ لاَ يَنْجُسُ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) came across me in one of the streets of Medina and at that time I was Junub. So I slipped away from him and went to take a bath. On my return the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Huraira! Where have you been?" I replied, "I was Junub, so I disliked to sit in your company." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Subhan Allah! A believer never becomes impure."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 35; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 281

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الْجُنُبُ يَخْرُجُ وَيَمْشِي فِي السُّوقِ وَغَيْرِهِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: A Junub person) can go out and walk in the market or anywhere else
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَقَالَ عَطَاءٌ يَحْتَجِمُ الْجُنُبُ وَيُقَلِّمُ أَظْفَارَهُ، وَيَحْلِقُ رَأْسَهُ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ.

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، أَنَّ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ، حَدَّثَهُمْ أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَطُوفُ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ فِي اللَّيْلَةِ الْوَاحِدَةِ، وَلَهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ تِسْعُ نِسْوَةٍ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to visit all his wives in one night and he had nine wives at that time.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 36; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 282

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَيَّاشٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ ، عَنْ بَكْرٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، قَالَ لَقِيَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا جُنُبٌ، فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِي، فَمَشَيْتُ مَعَهُ حَتَّى قَعَدَ فَانْسَلَلْتُ، فَأَتَيْتُ الرَّحْلَ، فَاغْتَسَلْتُ ثُمَّ جِئْتُ وَهْوَ قَاعِدٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ كُنْتَ يَا أَبَا هِرٍّ ‏"‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ يَا أَبَا هِرٍّ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ لاَ يَنْجُسُ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came across me and I was Junub. He took my hand and I went along with him till he sat down I slipped away, went home and took a bath. When I came back, he was still sitting there. He then said to me, "O Abu Huraira! Where have you been?' I told him about it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Subhan Allah! O Abu Huraira! A believer never becomes impure."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 37; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 283

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب كَيْنُونَةِ الْجُنُبِ فِي الْبَيْتِ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: A Junub can stay at home without taking a bath but with ablution

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، وَشَيْبَانُ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ أَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرْقُدُ وَهْوَ جُنُبٌ قَالَتْ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: نَعَمْ وَيَتَوَضَّأُ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I asked `Aisha "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) use to sleep while he was Junub?" She replied, "Yes, but he used to perform ablution (before going to bed).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 38; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 284

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب نَوْمِ الْجُنُبِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Sleeping of a Junub person

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَيَرْقُدُ أَحَدُنَا وَهْوَ جُنُبٌ قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: نَعَمْ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَرْقُدْ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "Can any one of us sleep while he is Junub?" He replied, "Yes, if he performs ablution, he can sleep while he is Junub."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 39; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 285

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الْجُنُبِ يَتَوَضَّأُ ثُمَّ يَنَامُ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: A Junub person should perform ablution before sleeping

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنَامَ وَهْوَ جُنُبٌ، غَسَلَ فَرْجَهُ، وَتَوَضَّأَ لِلصَّلاَةِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) intended to sleep while he was Junub, he used to wash his private parts and perform ablution like that for the prayer.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 40; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 286

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ اسْتَفْتَى عُمَرُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَيَنَامُ أَحَدُنَا وَهْوَ جُنُبٌ قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: نَعَمْ، إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: `Umar asked the Prophet (ﷺ) "Can anyone of us sleep while he is Junub?" He replied, "Yes, if he performs ablution."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 41; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 287

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ ذَكَرَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ تُصِيبُهُ الْجَنَابَةُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: تَوَضَّأْ وَاغْسِلْ ذَكَرَكَ ثُمَّ نَمْ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: `Umar bin Al-Khattab told Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "I became Junub at night." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "Perform ablution after washing your private parts and then sleep."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 42; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 288

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب إِذَا الْتَقَى الْخِتَانَانِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: When male and female organs come in close contact (bath becomes compulsory)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا جَلَسَ بَيْنَ شُعَبِهَا الأَرْبَعِ ثُمَّ جَهَدَهَا، فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْغَسْلُ ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَمْرُو بْنُ مَرْزُوقٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ مِثْلَهُ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: as the following Hadith 290. Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When a man sits in between the four parts of a woman and did the sexual intercourse with her, bath becomes compulsory."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 43; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 289

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب غَسْلِ مَا يُصِيبُ مِنْ فَرْجِ الْمَرْأَةِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Washing away what comes out from the private parts of a woman (woman's discharge) if one gets soiled with that

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ ، عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ ، قَالَ يَحْيَى وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ ، أَنَّ عَطَاءَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَأَلَ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ فَقَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِذَا جَامَعَ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ فَلَمْ يُمْنِ‏.‏ قَالَ عُثْمَانُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَتَوَضَّأُ كَمَا يَتَوَضَّأُ لِلصَّلاَةِ، وَيَغْسِلُ ذَكَرَهُ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: قَالَ عُثْمَانُ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَسَأَلْتُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ وَالزُّبَيْرَ بْنَ الْعَوَّامِ وَطَلْحَةَ بْنَ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ وَأُبَىَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ فَأَمَرُوهُ بِذَلِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ يَحْيَى وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا أَيُّوبَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I asked `Uthman bin `Affan about a man who engaged in the sexual intercourse with his wife but did not discharge. `Uthman replied, "He should perform ablution like that for the prayer after washing his private parts." `Uthman added, "I heard that from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." I asked `Ali bin Abi Talib, Az- Zubair bin Al-`Awwam, Talha bin 'Ubaidullah and Ubai bin Ka`b and they gave the same reply. (Abu Aiyub said that he had heard that from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ) (This order was canceled later on so one has to take a bath. See, Hadith No. 180).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 44; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 291

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو أَيُّوبَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِذَا جَامَعَ الرَّجُلُ الْمَرْأَةَ فَلَمْ يُنْزِلْ قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَغْسِلُ مَا مَسَّ الْمَرْأَةَ مِنْهُ، ثُمَّ يَتَوَضَّأُ وَيُصَلِّي ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْغَسْلُ أَحْوَطُ، وَذَاكَ الآخِرُ، وَإِنَّمَا بَيَّنَّا لاِخْتِلاَفِهِمْ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about a man who engages in sexual intercourse with his wife but does not discharge. He replied, "He should wash the parts which comes in contact with the private parts of the woman, perform ablution and then pray." (Abu `Abdullah said, "Taking a bath is safer and is the last order.")
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 5, Hadith 45; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 5, Hadith 292

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب كَيْفَ كَانَ بَدْءُ الْحَيْضِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: How the menses started
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَقَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَذَا شَىْءٌ كَتَبَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى بَنَاتِ آدَمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ كَانَ أَوَّلُ مَا أُرْسِلَ الْحَيْضُ عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، وَحَدِيثُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكْثَرُ‏.‏
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: And the statement of the Prophet ﷺ, “This is a thing which Allah has ordained for the daughters of Adam.” Some people said that the menses first came for Bani Israel. But what the Prophet ﷺ said is more comprehensive (the truth). ​​

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الأَمْرِ بِالنُّفَسَاءِ إِذَا نُفِسْنَ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Menses (a thing) ordained (by Allah and instructions) for women when they get their menses

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الْقَاسِمِ ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْقَاسِمَ ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ ، تَقُولُ خَرَجْنَا لاَ نَرَى إِلاَّ الْحَجَّ، فَلَمَّا كُنَّا بِسَرِفَ حِضْتُ، فَدَخَلَ عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا أَبْكِي قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكِ أَنُفِسْتِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِنَّ هَذَا أَمْرٌ كَتَبَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى بَنَاتِ آدَمَ، فَاقْضِي مَا يَقْضِي الْحَاجُّ، غَيْرَ أَنْ لاَ تَطُوفِي بِالْبَيْتِ ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَضَحَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ نِسَائِهِ بِالْبَقَرِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: `Aisha said, "We set out with the sole intention of performing Hajj and when we reached Sarif, (a place six miles from Mecca) I got my menses. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me while I was weeping. He said 'What is the matter with you? Have you got your menses?' I replied, 'Yes.' He said, 'This is a thing which Allah has ordained for the daughters of Adam. So do what all the pilgrims do with the exception of the Tawaf (Circumambulation) round the Ka`ba." `Aisha added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sacrificed cows on behalf of his wives."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 1; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 293

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب غَسْلِ الْحَائِضِ رَأْسَ زَوْجِهَا وَتَرْجِيلِهِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The washing of the husband's head and the combing of his hair by a menstruating wife

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: كُنْتُ أُرَجِّلُ رَأْسَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: While in menses, I used to comb the hair of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) .
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 2; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 294

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ ، أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ أَتَخْدُمُنِي الْحَائِضُ أَوْ تَدْنُو مِنِّي الْمَرْأَةُ وَهْىَ جُنُبٌ فَقَالَ عُرْوَةُ كُلُّ ذَلِكَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ، وَكُلُّ ذَلِكَ تَخْدُمُنِي، وَلَيْسَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ فِي ذَلِكَ بَأْسٌ، أَخْبَرَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: تُرَجِّلُ ـ تَعْنِي ـ رَأْسَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَئِذٍ مُجَاوِرٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، يُدْنِي لَهَا رَأْسَهُ وَهْىَ فِي حُجْرَتِهَا، فَتُرَجِّلُهُ وَهْىَ حَائِضٌ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: A person asked me, "Can a woman in menses serve me? And can a Junub woman come close to me?" I replied, "All this is easy for me. All of them can serve me, and there is no harm for any other person to do the same. `Aisha told me that she used to comb the hair of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while she was in her menses, and he was in I`tikaf (in the mosque). He would bring his head near her in her room and she would comb his hair, while she used to be in her menses."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 3; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 295

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب قِرَاءَةِ الرَّجُلِ فِي حَجْرِ امْرَأَتِهِ وَهْىَ حَائِضٌ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To recite the Qur'an while lying in the lap of one's own menstruating wife
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَكَانَ أَبُو وَائِلٍ يُرْسِلُ خَادِمَهُ وَهْيَ حَائِضٌ إِلَى أَبِي رَزِينٍ، فَتَأْتِيهِ بِالْمُصْحَفِ فَتُمْسِكُهُ بِعِلاَقَتِهِ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: Abu Wa’il used to send his menstruating maid servant to bring the Qur’an from Abi Razin by carrying it from the hanger (of its case). ​​

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دُكَيْنٍ ، سَمِعَ زُهَيْرًا ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ابْنِ صَفِيَّةَ ، أَنَّ أُمَّهُ ، حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ حَدَّثَتْهَا أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَتَّكِئُ فِي حَجْرِي وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ، ثُمَّ يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to lean on my lap and recite Qur'an while I was in menses.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 4; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 296

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَنْ سَمَّى النِّفَاسَ حَيْضًا
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Using the word Nifas for menses

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةَ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ ، حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَتْهَا قَالَتْ، بَيْنَا أَنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مُضْطَجِعَةً فِي خَمِيصَةٍ إِذْ حِضْتُ، فَانْسَلَلْتُ فَأَخَذْتُ ثِيَابَ حِيضَتِي قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنُفِسْتِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَدَعَانِي فَاضْطَجَعْتُ مَعَهُ فِي الْخَمِيلَةِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: While I was laying with the Prophet (ﷺ) under a single woolen sheet, I got the menses. I slipped away and put on the clothes for menses. He said, "Have you got "Nifas" (menses)?" I replied, "Yes." He then called me and made me lie with him under the same sheet.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 5; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 297

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مُبَاشَرَةِ الْحَائِضِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Fondling a menstruating wife

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ، كِلاَنَا جُنُبٌ‏.‏ وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُنِي فَأَتَّزِرُ، فَيُبَاشِرُنِي وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ‏.‏ وَكَانَ يُخْرِجُ رَأْسَهُ إِلَىَّ وَهُوَ مُعْتَكِفٌ، فَأَغْسِلُهُ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) and I used to take a bath from a single pot while we were Junub. During the menses, he used to order me to put on an Izar (dress worn below the waist) and used to fondle me. While in I`tikaf, he used to bring his head near me and I would wash it while I used to be in my periods (menses).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 6; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 298

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ خَلِيلٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ ـ هُوَ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ ـ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: كَانَتْ إِحْدَانَا إِذَا كَانَتْ حَائِضًا، فَأَرَادَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُبَاشِرَهَا، أَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَتَّزِرَ فِي فَوْرِ حَيْضَتِهَا ثُمَّ يُبَاشِرُهَا‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَأَيُّكُمْ يَمْلِكُ إِرْبَهُ كَمَا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْلِكُ إِرْبَهُ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: تَابَعَهُ خَالِدٌ وَجَرِيرٌ عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: (on the authority of his father) `Aisha said: "Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wanted to fondle anyone of us during her periods (menses), he used to order her to put on an Izar and start fondling her." `Aisha added, "None of you could control his sexual desires as the Prophet (ﷺ) could."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 7; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 299

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الشَّيْبَانِيُّ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَيْمُونَةَ ، كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يُبَاشِرَ امْرَأَةً مِنْ نِسَائِهِ أَمَرَهَا فَاتَّزَرَتْ وَهْىَ حَائِضٌ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: وَرَوَاهُ سُفْيَانُ عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: When ever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wanted to fondle any of his wives during the periods (menses), he used to ask her to wear an Izar.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 8; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 300

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب تَرْكِ الْحَائِضِ الصَّوْمَ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: A menstruating women should leave observing Saum (fasting)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي زَيْدٌ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ أَسْلَمَ ـ عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ، قَالَ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي أَضْحًى ـ أَوْ فِطْرٍ ـ إِلَى الْمُصَلَّى، فَمَرَّ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَا مَعْشَرَ النِّسَاءِ تَصَدَّقْنَ، فَإِنِّي أُرِيتُكُنَّ أَكْثَرَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْنَ وَبِمَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ تُكْثِرْنَ اللَّعْنَ، وَتَكْفُرْنَ الْعَشِيرَ، مَا رَأَيْتُ مِنْ نَاقِصَاتِ عَقْلٍ وَدِينٍ أَذْهَبَ لِلُبِّ الرَّجُلِ الْحَازِمِ مِنْ إِحْدَاكُنَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَ وَمَا نُقْصَانُ دِينِنَا وَعَقْلِنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَيْسَ شَهَادَةُ الْمَرْأَةِ مِثْلَ نِصْفِ شَهَادَةِ الرَّجُلِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَ بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَذَلِكَ مِنْ نُقْصَانِ عَقْلِهَا، أَلَيْسَ إِذَا حَاضَتْ لَمْ تُصَلِّ وَلَمْ تَصُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَ بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَذَلِكَ مِنْ نُقْصَانِ دِينِهَا ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out to the Musalla (to offer the prayer) of `Id-al-Adha or Al-Fitr prayer. Then he passed by the women and said, "O women! Give alms, as I have seen that the majority of the dwellers of Hell-fire were you (women)." They asked, "Why is it so, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?" He replied, "You curse frequently and are ungrateful to your husbands. I have not seen anyone more deficient in intelligence and religion than you. A cautious sensible man could be led astray by some of you." The women asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is deficient in our intelligence and religion?" He said, "Is not the evidence of two women equal to the witness of one man?" They replied in the affirmative. He said, "This is the deficiency in her intelligence. Isn't it true that a woman can neither pray nor fast during her menses?" The women replied in the affirmative. He said, "This is the deficiency in her religion."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 9; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 301

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب تَقْضِي الْحَائِضُ الْمَنَاسِكَ كُلَّهَا إِلاَّ الطَّوَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: A menstruating women should perform all the ceremonies of Hajj except the Tawaf around the Ka'bah
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لاَ بَأْسَ أَنْ تَقْرَأَ الآيَةَ. وَلَمْ يَرَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ بِالْقِرَاءَةِ لِلْجُنُبِ بَأْسًا. وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ أَحْيَانِهِ. وَقَالَتْ أُمُّ عَطِيَّةَ كُنَّا نُؤْمَرُ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ الْحُيَّضُ، فَيُكَبِّرْنَ بِتَكْبِيرِهِمْ وَيَدْعُونَ. وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سُفْيَانَ أَنَّ هِرَقْلَ دَعَا بِكِتَابِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَرَأَ فَإِذَا فِيهِ: «بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَ{يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ تَعَالَوْا إِلَى كَلِمَةٍ}». الآيَةَ. وَقَالَ عَطَاءٌ عَنْ جَابِرٍ حَاضَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَنَسَكَتِ الْمَنَاسِكَ غَيْرَ الطَّوَافِ بِالْبَيْتِ، وَلاَ تُصَلِّي. وَقَالَ الْحَكَمُ إِنِّي لأَذْبَحُ وَأَنَا جُنُبٌ. وَقَالَ اللَّهُ: {وَلاَ تَأْكُلُوا مِمَّا لَمْ يُذْكَرِ اسْمُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ}.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: Ibrahim said, “There is no harm in reciting a Verse of the Qur’an by a menstruating woman.” Ibn ‘Abbas considers that there was no harm in the recitation of the Qur’an by a Junub. The Prophet ﷺ used to remember (glorify) Allah at all times. Umm ‘Atiyya said that they were ordered to let the menstruating women come out (on festivals) to say Takbirat (Allahu-Akbar), and to invoke Allah. Ibn ‘Abbas narrated on the authority of Abu Sufyan: Heraclius asked for the letter of the Prophet ﷺ and read it. It began: “In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. O people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians): Come to a word that is just between us and you that we worship none but Allah …” (V.3:64). And ‘Ata quoted from Jabir, “Aishah رضي الله عنها got her menses and she performed all the ceremonies of Hajj except the Tawaf round the Ka‘bah and she did not offer Salat (prayers).” Al-Hakam said, “I slaughter the animal even if I were Junub.” And Allah جل جلاله said: “Eat not (O believers) of that (meat) on which Allah’s Name has not been pronounced (at the time of slaughtering of the animal).” (V.6:121).

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ نَذْكُرُ إِلاَّ الْحَجَّ، فَلَمَّا جِئْنَا سَرِفَ طَمِثْتُ، فَدَخَلَ عَلَىَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا أَبْكِي فَقَالَ ‏{‏مَا يُبْكِيكِ‏}‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَوَدِدْتُ وَاللَّهِ أَنِّي لَمْ أَحُجَّ الْعَامَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏{‏لَعَلَّكِ نُفِسْتِ‏}‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ شَىْءٌ كَتَبَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى بَنَاتِ آدَمَ، فَافْعَلِي مَا يَفْعَلُ الْحَاجُّ، غَيْرَ أَنْ لاَ تَطُوفِي بِالْبَيْتِ حَتَّى تَطْهُرِي ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: We set out with the Prophet (ﷺ) for Hajj and when we reached Sarif I got my menses. When the Prophet (ﷺ) came to me, I was weeping. He asked, "Why are you weeping?" I said, "I wish if I had not performed Hajj this year." He asked, "May be that you got your menses?" I replied, "Yes." He then said, "This is the thing which Allah has ordained for all the daughters of Adam. So do what all the pilgrims do except that you do not perform the Tawaf round the Ka`ba till you are clean."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 10; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 302

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الاِسْتِحَاضَةِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Al-Isthihada [bleeding (from the womb) in between a woman's periods]

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ قَالَتْ فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ أَبِي حُبَيْشٍ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي لاَ أَطْهُرُ، أَفَأَدَعُ الصَّلاَةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِنَّمَا ذَلِكِ عِرْقٌ وَلَيْسَ بِالْحَيْضَةِ، فَإِذَا أَقْبَلَتِ الْحَيْضَةُ فَاتْرُكِي الصَّلاَةَ، فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ قَدْرُهَا فَاغْسِلِي عَنْكِ الدَّمَ وَصَلِّي ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Fatima bint Abi Hubaish said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I do not become clean (from bleeding). Shall I give up my prayers?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied: "No, because it is from a blood vessel and not the menses. So when the real menses begins give up your prayers and when it (the period) has finished wash the blood off your body (take a bath) and offer your prayers."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 11; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 303

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب غَسْلِ دَمِ الْمَحِيضِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Washing out the menstrual blood

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ الْمُنْذِرِ ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ سَأَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَرَأَيْتَ إِحْدَانَا إِذَا أَصَابَ ثَوْبَهَا الدَّمُ مِنَ الْحَيْضَةِ، كَيْفَ تَصْنَعُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا أَصَابَ ثَوْبَ إِحْدَاكُنَّ الدَّمُ مِنَ الْحَيْضَةِ، فَلْتَقْرُصْهُ ثُمَّ لِتَنْضَحْهُ بِمَاءٍ، ثُمَّ لِتُصَلِّي فِيهِ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: A woman asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What should we do, if the blood of menses falls on our clothes?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "If the blood of menses falls on the garment of anyone of you, she must take hold of the blood spot, rub it, and wash it with water and then pray in (with it).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 12; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 304

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَصْبَغُ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: كَانَتْ إِحْدَانَا تَحِيضُ، ثُمَّ تَقْتَرِصُ الدَّمَ مِنْ ثَوْبِهَا عِنْدَ طُهْرِهَا فَتَغْسِلُهُ، وَتَنْضَحُ عَلَى سَائِرِهِ، ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي فِيهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Whenever anyone of us got her menses, she, on becoming clean, used to take hold of the blood spot and rub the blood off her garment, and pour water over it and wash that portion thoroughly and sprinkle water over the rest of the garment. After that she would pray in (with) it.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 13; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 305

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الاِعْتِكَافِ لِلْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The I'tikaf of a woman who is bleeding in between her periods

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: اعْتَكَفَ مَعَهُ بَعْضُ نِسَائِهِ وَهْىَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ تَرَى الدَّمَ، فَرُبَّمَا وَضَعَتِ الطَّسْتَ تَحْتَهَا مِنَ الدَّمِ‏.‏ وَزَعَمَ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ رَأَتْ مَاءَ الْعُصْفُرِ فَقَالَتْ كَأَنَّ هَذَا شَىْءٌ كَانَتْ فُلاَنَةُ تَجِدُهُ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Once one of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) did I`tikaf along with him and she was getting bleeding in between her periods. She used to see the blood (from her private parts) and she would perhaps put a dish under her for the blood. (The sub-narrator `Ikrima added, `Aisha once saw the liquid of safflower and said, "It looks like what so and so used to have.")
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 14; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 306

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتِ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: اعْتَكَفَتْ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِهِ، فَكَانَتْ تَرَى الدَّمَ وَالصُّفْرَةَ، وَالطَّسْتُ تَحْتَهَا وَهْىَ تُصَلِّي‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: "One of the wives of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) joined him in I`tikaf and she noticed blood and yellowish discharge (from her private parts) and put a dish under her when she prayed."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 15; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 307

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَنَّ بَعْضَ، أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اعْتَكَفَتْ وَهْىَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: One of the mothers of the faithful believers (i.e. the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) did I`tikaf while she was having bleeding in between her periods.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 16; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 308

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب هَلْ تُصَلِّي الْمَرْأَةُ فِي ثَوْبٍ حَاضَتْ فِيهِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Can a woman offer her Salat (prayers) in the clothes in which she has her menses?

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: مَا كَانَ لإِحْدَانَا إِلاَّ ثَوْبٌ وَاحِدٌ تَحِيضُ فِيهِ، فَإِذَا أَصَابَهُ شَىْءٌ مِنْ دَمٍ، قَالَتْ بِرِيقِهَا فَقَصَعَتْهُ بِظُفْرِهَا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: None of us had more than a single garment and we used to have our menses while wearing it. Whenever it got soiled with blood of menses we used to apply saliva to the blood spot and rub off the blood with our nails.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 17; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 309

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الطِّيبِ لِلْمَرْأَةِ عِنْدَ غُسْلِهَا مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Putting perfume by woman at the time of taking a bath after finishing from the menses

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ ـ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَوْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ حَفْصَةَ ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ ـ قَالَتْ كُنَّا
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: نُنْهَى أَنْ نُحِدَّ عَلَى مَيِّتٍ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ، إِلاَّ عَلَى زَوْجٍ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا، وَلاَ نَكْتَحِلَ وَلاَ نَتَطَيَّبَ وَلاَ نَلْبَسَ ثَوْبًا مَصْبُوغًا إِلاَّ ثَوْبَ عَصْبٍ، وَقَدْ رُخِّصَ لَنَا عِنْدَ الطُّهْرِ إِذَا اغْتَسَلَتْ إِحْدَانَا مِنْ مَحِيضِهَا فِي نُبْذَةٍ مِنْ كُسْتِ أَظْفَارٍ، وَكُنَّا نُنْهَى عَنِ اتِّبَاعِ الْجَنَائِزِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: قَالَ رَوَاهُ هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ عَنْ حَفْصَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_English: We were forbidden to mourn for a dead person for more than three days except in the case of a husband for whom mourning was allowed for four months and ten days. (During that time) we were not allowed to put kohl (Antimony eye power) in our eyes or to use perfumes or to put on colored clothes except a dress made of `Asr (a kind of Yemen cloth, very coarse and rough). We were allowed very light perfumes at the time of taking a bath after menses and also we were forbidden to go with the funeral procession .
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 18; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 310

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب دَلْكِ الْمَرْأَةِ نَفْسَهَا إِذَا تَطَهَّرَتْ مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: A woman should rub her own body thoroughly during a bath after the menses
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَكَيْفَ تَغْتَسِلُ، وَتَأْخُذُ فِرْصَةً مُمَسَّكَةً فَتَتَّبِعُ بِهَا أَثَرَ الدَّمِ
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: How to take a bath after menses and rub the place soiled with blood with a perfumed piece of cloth.

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورِ ابْنِ صَفِيَّةَ ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، سَأَلَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ غُسْلِهَا مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ، فَأَمَرَهَا كَيْفَ تَغْتَسِلُ قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: خُذِي فِرْصَةً مِنْ مِسْكٍ فَتَطَهَّرِي بِهَا
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ كَيْفَ أَتَطَهَّرُ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَطَهَّرِي بِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ كَيْفَ قَالَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ تَطَهَّرِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَاجْتَبَذْتُهَا إِلَىَّ فَقُلْتُ تَتَبَّعِي بِهَا أَثَرَ الدَّمِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: A woman asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about the bath which is taken after finishing from the menses. The Prophet (ﷺ) told her what to do and said, "Purify yourself with a piece of cloth scented with musk." The woman asked, "How shall I purify myself with it" He said, "Subhan Allah! Purify yourself (with it)." I pulled her to myself and said, "Rub the place soiled with blood with it."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 19; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 311

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب غُسْلِ الْمَحِيضِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To take a bath after finishing from the menses

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ قَالَتْ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَيْفَ أَغْتَسِلُ مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: خُذِي فِرْصَةً مُمَسَّكَةً، فَتَوَضَّئِي ثَلاَثًا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتَحْيَا فَأَعْرَضَ بِوَجْهِهِ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَوَضَّئِي بِهَا ‏"‏ فَأَخَذْتُهَا فَجَذَبْتُهَا فَأَخْبَرْتُهَا بِمَا يُرِيدُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_English: An Ansari woman asked the Prophet (ﷺ) how to take a bath after finishing from the menses. He replied, "Take a piece a cloth perfumed with musk and clean the private parts with it thrice." The Prophet (ﷺ) felt shy and turned his face. So I pulled her to me and told her what the Prophet (ﷺ) meant.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 20; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 312

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب امْتِشَاطِ الْمَرْأَةِ عِنْدَ غُسْلِهَا مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The combing of head-hair while taking the bath after finishing from her menses

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ أَهْلَلْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، فَكُنْتُ مِمَّنْ تَمَتَّعَ، وَلَمْ يَسُقِ الْهَدْىَ، فَزَعَمَتْ أَنَّهَا حَاضَتْ، وَلَمْ تَطْهُرْ حَتَّى دَخَلَتْ لَيْلَةُ عَرَفَةَ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَذِهِ لَيْلَةُ عَرَفَةَ، وَإِنَّمَا كُنْتُ تَمَتَّعْتُ بِعُمْرَةٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: انْقُضِي رَأْسَكِ، وَامْتَشِطِي، وَأَمْسِكِي عَنْ عُمْرَتِكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَفَعَلْتُ، فَلَمَّا قَضَيْتُ الْحَجَّ أَمَرَ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ لَيْلَةَ الْحَصْبَةِ فَأَعْمَرَنِي مِنَ التَّنْعِيمِ مَكَانَ عُمْرَتِي الَّتِي نَسَكْتُ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: In the last Hajj of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I assumed the Ihram for Hajj along with Allah Apostle. I was one of those who intended Tamattu` (to perform Hajj and `Umra) and did not take the Hadi (animal for sacrifice) with me. I got my menses and was not clean till the night of `Arafa I said, "O Allah's Apostle! It is the night of the day of `Arafat and I intended to perform the Hajj Tamattu` with `Umra. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told me to undo my hair and comb it and to postpone the `Umra. I did the same and completed the Hajj. On the night of Al-Hasba (i.e. place outside Mecca where the pilgrims go after finishing all the ceremonies of Hajj at Mina) he (the Prophet) ordered `Abdur Rahman (`Aisha's brother) to take me to at-Tan`im to assume the lhram for `Umra in lieu of that of Hajj-at-Tamattu` which I had intended to perform.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 21; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 313

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب نَقْضِ الْمَرْأَةِ شَعَرَهَا عِنْدَ غُسْلِ الْمَحِيضِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: A woman should undo her head-hair while taking the bath after finishing from her menses.

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ خَرَجْنَا مُوَافِينَ لِهِلاَلِ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُهِلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ فَلْيُهْلِلْ، فَإِنِّي لَوْلاَ أَنِّي أَهْدَيْتُ لأَهْلَلْتُ بِعُمْرَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَهَلَّ بَعْضُهُمْ بِعُمْرَةٍ، وَأَهَلَّ بَعْضُهُمْ بِحَجٍّ، وَكُنْتُ أَنَا مِمَّنْ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ، فَأَدْرَكَنِي يَوْمُ عَرَفَةَ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ، فَشَكَوْتُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ دَعِي عُمْرَتَكِ، وَانْقُضِي رَأْسَكِ وَامْتَشِطِي، وَأَهِلِّي بِحَجٍّ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَفَعَلْتُ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ لَيْلَةُ الْحَصْبَةِ أَرْسَلَ مَعِي أَخِي عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، فَخَرَجْتُ إِلَى التَّنْعِيمِ، فَأَهْلَلْتُ بِعُمْرَةٍ مَكَانَ عُمْرَتِي‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: قَالَ هِشَامٌ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ ذَلِكَ هَدْىٌ وَلاَ صَوْمٌ وَلاَ صَدَقَةٌ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: On the 1st of Dhul-Hijja we set out with the intention of performing Hajj. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Any one who likes to assume the Ihram for `Umra he can do so. Had I not brought the Hadi with me, I would have assumed the Ihram for `Umra. "Some of us assumed the Ihram for `Umra while the others assumed the Ihram for Hajj. I was one of those who assumed the Ihram for `Umra. I got menses and kept on menstruating until the day of `Arafat and complained of that to the Prophet. He told me to postpone my `Umra, undo and comb my hair, and to assume the Ihram of Hajj and I did so. On the night of Hasba, he sent my brother `Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr with me to at-Tan`im, where I assumed the Ihram for `Umra in lieu of the previous one. Hisham said, "For that (`Umra) no Hadi, fasting or alms were required.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 22; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 314

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مُخَلَّقَةٍ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: "(A little lump of flesh) some formed and some unformed."

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ ـ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ـ وَكَّلَ بِالرَّحِمِ مَلَكًا يَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ نُطْفَةٌ، يَا رَبِّ عَلَقَةٌ، يَا رَبِّ مُضْغَةٌ‏.‏ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ خَلْقَهُ قَالَ أَذَكَرٌ أَمْ أُنْثَى شَقِيٌّ أَمْ سَعِيدٌ فَمَا الرِّزْقُ وَالأَجَلُ فَيُكْتَبُ فِي بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "At every womb Allah appoints an angel who says, 'O Lord! A drop of semen, O Lord! A clot. O Lord! A little lump of flesh." Then if Allah wishes (to complete) its creation, the angel asks, (O Lord!) Will it be a male or female, a wretched or a blessed, and how much will his provision be? And what will his age be?' So all that is written while the child is still in the mother's womb."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 23; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 315

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب كَيْفَ تُهِلُّ الْحَائِضُ بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: How a menstruating woman should assume Ihram for Hajj or for Umra

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، فَمِنَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ، وَمِنَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِحَجٍّ، فَقَدِمْنَا مَكَّةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: مَنْ أَحْرَمَ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَلَمْ يُهْدِ فَلْيُحْلِلْ، وَمَنْ أَحْرَمَ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَأَهْدَى فَلاَ يَحِلُّ حَتَّى يَحِلَّ بِنَحْرِ هَدْيِهِ، وَمَنْ أَهَلَّ بِحَجٍّ فَلْيُتِمَّ حَجَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَحِضْتُ فَلَمْ أَزَلْ حَائِضًا حَتَّى كَانَ يَوْمُ عَرَفَةَ، وَلَمْ أُهْلِلْ إِلاَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ، فَأَمَرَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ أَنْقُضَ رَأْسِي وَأَمْتَشِطَ، وَأُهِلَّ بِحَجٍّ، وَأَتْرُكَ الْعُمْرَةَ، فَفَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى قَضَيْتُ حَجِّي، فَبَعَثَ مَعِي عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَعْتَمِرَ مَكَانَ عُمْرَتِي مِنَ التَّنْعِيمِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: `Aisha said, "We set out with the Prophet (ﷺ) in his last Hajj. Some of us intended to perform `Umra while others Hajj. When we reached Mecca, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Those who had assumed the lhram for `Umra and had not brought the Hadi should finish his lhram and whoever had assumed the Ihram for `Umra and brought the Hadi should not finish the Ihram till he has slaughtered his Hadi and whoever had assumed the lhram for Hajj should complete his Hajj." `Aisha further said, "I got my periods (menses) and kept on menstruating till the day of `Arafat, and I had assumed the Ihram for `Umra only (Tamattu`). The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered me to undo and comb my head hair and assume the lhram for Hajj only and leave the `Umra. I did the same till I completed the Hajj. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) sent `Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr with me and ordered me to perform `Umra from at-Tan`im in lieu of the missed `Umra."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 24; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 316

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب إِقْبَالِ الْمَحِيضِ وَإِدْبَارِهِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The beginning and the ending of menstrual periods
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَكُنَّ نِسَاءٌ يَبْعَثْنَ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ بِالدُّرْجَةِ فِيهَا الْكُرْسُفُ فِيهِ الصُّفْرَةُ فَتَقُولُ لاَ تَعْجَلْنَ حَتَّى تَرَيْنَ الْقَصَّةَ الْبَيْضَاءَ. تُرِيدُ بِذَلِكَ الطُّهْرَ مِنَ الْحَيْضَةِ. وَبَلَغَ ابْنَةَ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ أَنَّ نِسَاءً يَدْعُونَ بِالْمَصَابِيحِ مِنْ جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ يَنْظُرْنَ إِلَى الطُّهْرِ فَقَالَتْ مَا كَانَ النِّسَاءُ يَصْنَعْنَ هَذَا. وَعَابَتْ عَلَيْهِنَّ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: Some women used to send the pads of cotton with traces of yellowish discharge to ‘Aishah رضي الله عنها (for her verdict to know whether they had become clean from menses or not). And ‘Aishah رضي الله عنها would say, “Do not hurry till you see the cotton pad is white (meaning the perfect disappearance of menses).” The daughter of Zaid bin Thabit was told that some women used to ask for candles at midnight to see whether the menses had stopped or not. On that, the daughter of Zaid said that the ladies (the wives of the Prophet’s Companions) had never done so, and she blamed them (the former women).

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ أَبِي حُبَيْشٍ، كَانَتْ تُسْتَحَاضُ فَسَأَلَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: ذَلِكِ عِرْقٌ، وَلَيْسَتْ بِالْحَيْضَةِ، فَإِذَا أَقْبَلَتِ الْحَيْضَةُ فَدَعِي الصَّلاَةَ، وَإِذَا أَدْبَرَتْ فَاغْتَسِلِي وَصَلِّي ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Fatima bint Abi Hubaish used to have bleeding in between the periods, so she asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about it. He replied, "The bleeding is from a blood vessel and not the menses. So give up the prayers when the (real) menses begins and when it has finished, take a bath and start praying."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 6, Hadith 25; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 6, Hadith 317

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب لاَ تَقْضِي الْحَائِضُ الصَّلاَةَ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: There is no Salat (prayer) to be offered by a menstruating woman in lieu of the missed Salat during her menses.
