Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب وَقْتِ الْمَغْرِبِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The time of the Maghrib prayer (evening prayer)
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَقَالَ عَطَاءٌ يَجْمَعُ الْمَرِيضُ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: ‘Ata' said: "A person who is sick can offer Maghrib and Isha' prayers together."

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النَّجَاشِيِّ، صُهَيْبٌ مَوْلَى رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَافِعَ بْنَ خَدِيجٍ ، يَقُولُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: كُنَّا نُصَلِّي الْمَغْرِبَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَنْصَرِفُ أَحَدُنَا وَإِنَّهُ لَيُبْصِرُ مَوَاقِعَ نَبْلِهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: We used to offer the Maghrib prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and after finishing the prayer one of us may go away and could still see as Par as the spots where one's arrow might reach when shot by a bow.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 36; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 534

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ، قَالَ قَدِمَ الْحَجَّاجُ فَسَأَلْنَا جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ بِالْهَاجِرَةِ، وَالْعَصْرَ وَالشَّمْسُ نَقِيَّةٌ، وَالْمَغْرِبَ إِذَا وَجَبَتْ، وَالْعِشَاءَ أَحْيَانًا وَأَحْيَانًا، إِذَا رَآهُمُ اجْتَمَعُوا عَجَّلَ، وَإِذَا رَآهُمْ أَبْطَوْا أَخَّرَ، وَالصُّبْحَ كَانُوا ـ أَوْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّيهَا بِغَلَسٍ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray the Zuhr at midday, and the `Asr at a time when the sun was still bright, the Maghrib after sunset (at its stated time) and the `Isha at a variable time. Whenever he saw the people assembled (for `Isha' prayer) he would pray earlier and if the people delayed, he would delay the prayer. And they or the Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer the Fajr Prayers when it still dark.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 37; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 535

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ ، قَالَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: كُنَّا نُصَلِّي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَغْرِبَ إِذَا تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: We used to pray the Maghrib prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) when the sun disappeared from the horizon.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 38; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 536

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، قَالَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَبْعًا جَمِيعًا وَثَمَانِيًا جَمِيعًا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed seven rak`at together and eight rak`at together.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 39; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 537

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَنْ كَرِهَ أَنْ يُقَالَ لِلْمَغْرِبِ الْعِشَاءُ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Whoever disliked to call the Maghrib prayer as the 'Isha' prayer

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ ـ هُوَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو ـ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ ، عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيُّ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: لاَ تَغْلِبَنَّكُمُ الأَعْرَابُ عَلَى اسْمِ صَلاَتِكُمُ الْمَغْرِبِ ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏‏.‏ قَالَ الأَعْرَابُ وَتَقُولُ هِيَ الْعِشَاءُ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not be influenced by bedouins regarding the name of your Maghrib prayer which is called `Isha' by them."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 40; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 538

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب ذِكْرِ الْعِشَاءِ وَالْعَتَمَةِ وَمَنْ رَآهُ وَاسِعًا
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The mention of 'Isha' and 'Atama and whoever took the two names as one and the same
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «أَثْقَلُ الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ الْعِشَاءُ وَالْفَجْرُ». وَقَالَ: «لَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِي الْعَتَمَةِ وَالْفَجْرِ». قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَالاِخْتِيَارُ أَنْ يَقُولَ الْعِشَاءُ لِقَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: {وَمِنْ بَعْدِ صَلاَةِ الْعِشَاءِ}. وَيُذْكَرُ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى قَالَ كُنَّا نَتَنَاوَبُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عِنْدَ صَلاَةِ الْعِشَاءِ فَأَعْتَمَ بِهَا. وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَعَائِشَةُ أَعْتَمَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالْعِشَاءِ. وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أَعْتَمَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالْعَتَمَةِ. وَقَالَ جَابِرٌ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُصَلِّي الْعِشَاءَ. وَقَالَ أَبُو بَرْزَةَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُؤَخِّرُ الْعِشَاءَ. وَقَالَ أَنَسٌ أَخَّرَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْعِشَاءَ الآخِرَةَ. وَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَأَبُو أَيُّوبَ وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: Narrated Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The most difficult and the hardest Salat (prayers) for the hypocrites are the Isha' (prayer) and the Fajr (prayer)." He added, "Had they known what is (the reward of) the Atama ('Isha') and the Fajr (prayers) they would have come to attend them even if they had to crawl." Few discussions about Maghrib, 'Atama i.e. 'Isha', which are merely repetition of the topic of this chapter, are mentioned here in the Arabic text. Abu Abdullah (Bukhari) said: It is better that one should call it Isha because of the words of Allah, the Most High: “…and after the Isha prayer” (the Quran, 24:58). It has been related of Abu Musa that he said: We used to take turns to be with the Prophet ﷺ at Isha prayer and he would say it late. Ibn Abbas and Aishah said: The Prophet ﷺ delayed the Isha prayer. Some reported from Aishah that the Prophet ﷺ delayed the Atamah prayer. Jabir said: The Prophet ﷺ used to say the Isha prayer. Abu Barzah said: The Prophet ﷺ used to delay the Isha prayer. Anas said: The Prophet ﷺ delayed the late Isha prayer. Ibn Umar, Abu Ayyub and Ibn Abbas said: The Prophet ﷺ said the Maghrib and the Isha prayers.

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، قَالَ سَالِمٌ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ صَلَّى لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةً صَلاَةَ الْعِشَاءِ ـ وَهْىَ الَّتِي يَدْعُو النَّاسُ الْعَتَمَةَ ـ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَرَأَيْتُمْ لَيْلَتَكُمْ هَذِهِ فَإِنَّ رَأْسَ مِائَةِ سَنَةٍ مِنْهَا لاَ يَبْقَى مِمَّنْ هُوَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الأَرْضِ أَحَدٌ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: "One night Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us in the `Isha' prayer and that is the one called Al-`Atma [??] by the people. After the completion of the prayer, he faced us and said, "Do you know the importance of this night? Nobody present on the surface of the earth tonight will be living after one hundred years from this night." (See Hadith No. 575).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 41; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 539

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب وَقْتِ الْعِشَاءِ إِذَا اجْتَمَعَ النَّاسُ أَوْ تَأَخَّرُوا
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The time of the Isha prayer. If the people get together (pray earlier), and if they come late (delay it)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ـ هُوَ ابْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ـ قَالَ سَأَلْنَا جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ صَلاَةِ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ كَانَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ بِالْهَاجِرَةِ، وَالْعَصْرَ وَالشَّمْسُ حَيَّةٌ، وَالْمَغْرِبَ إِذَا وَجَبَتْ، وَالْعِشَاءَ إِذَا كَثُرَ النَّاسُ عَجَّلَ، وَإِذَا قَلُّوا أَخَّرَ، وَالصُّبْحَ بِغَلَسٍ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: We asked Jabir bin `Abdullah about the prayers of the Prophet (ﷺ) . He said, "He used to pray Zuhr prayer at midday, the `Asr when the sun was still hot, and the Maghrib after sunset (at its stated time). The `Isha was offered early if the people gathered, and used to be delayed if their number was less; and the morning prayer was offered when it was still dark. "
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 42; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 540

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب فَضْلِ الْعِشَاءِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Superiority of the 'Isha prayer

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ قَالَتْ،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَعْتَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةً بِالْعِشَاءِ، وَذَلِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَفْشُوَ الإِسْلاَمُ، فَلَمْ يَخْرُجْ حَتَّى قَالَ عُمَرُ نَامَ النِّسَاءُ وَالصِّبْيَانُ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ فَقَالَ لأَهْلِ الْمَسْجِدِ ‏"‏ مَا يَنْتَظِرُهَا أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ غَيْرُكُمْ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) once delayed the `Isha' prayer and that was during the days when Islam still had not spread. The Prophet (ﷺ) did not come out till `Umar informed him that the women and children had slept. Then he came out and said to the people of the mosque: "None amongst the dwellers of the earth has been waiting for it (`Isha prayer) except you."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 43; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 541

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَنَا وَأَصْحَابِي الَّذِينَ، قَدِمُوا مَعِي فِي السَّفِينَةِ نُزُولاً فِي بَقِيعِ بُطْحَانَ، وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْمَدِينَةِ، فَكَانَ يَتَنَاوَبُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ صَلاَةِ الْعِشَاءِ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ نَفَرٌ مِنْهُمْ، فَوَافَقْنَا النَّبِيَّ ـ عليه السلام ـ أَنَا وَأَصْحَابِي وَلَهُ بَعْضُ الشُّغْلِ فِي بَعْضِ أَمْرِهِ فَأَعْتَمَ بِالصَّلاَةِ حَتَّى ابْهَارَّ اللَّيْلُ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ، فَلَمَّا قَضَى صَلاَتَهُ قَالَ لِمَنْ حَضَرَهُ ‏"‏ عَلَى رِسْلِكُمْ،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَبْشِرُوا إِنَّ مِنْ نِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ يُصَلِّي هَذِهِ السَّاعَةَ غَيْرُكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا صَلَّى هَذِهِ السَّاعَةَ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكُمْ ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏‏.‏ لاَ يَدْرِي أَىَّ الْكَلِمَتَيْنِ قَالَ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى فَرَجَعْنَا فَفَرِحْنَا بِمَا سَمِعْنَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_English: My companions, who came with me in the boat and I landed at a place called Baqi [??] Buthan [??] . The Prophet (ﷺ) was in Medina at that time. One of us used to go to the Prophet (ﷺ) by turns every night at the time of the `Isha prayer. Once I along with my companions went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he was busy in some of his affairs, so the `Isha' prayer was delayed to the middle of the night He then came out and led the people (in prayer). After finishing from the prayer, he addressed the people present there saying, "Be patient! Don't go away. Have the glad tiding. It is from the blessing of Allah upon you that none amongst mankind has prayed at this time save you." Or said, "None except you has prayed at this time." Abu Musa added, 'So we returned happily after what we heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 44; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 542

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَا يُكْرَهُ مِنَ النَّوْمِ قَبْلَ الْعِشَاءِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: What is disliked about sleeping before the 'Isha prayer

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمِنْهَالِ ، عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَكْرَهُ النَّوْمَ قَبْلَ الْعِشَاءِ وَالْحَدِيثَ بَعْدَهَا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disliked to sleep before the `Isha' prayer and to talk after it.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 45; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 543

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب النَّوْمِ قَبْلَ الْعِشَاءِ لِمَنْ غُلِبَ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Sleeping before the 'Isha prayer if (one is) over-whelmed by it (sleep)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ ، قَالَ صَالِحُ بْنُ كَيْسَانَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ أَعْتَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْعِشَاءِ حَتَّى نَادَاهُ عُمَرُ الصَّلاَةَ، نَامَ النِّسَاءُ وَالصِّبْيَانُ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: مَا يَنْتَظِرُهَا أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ غَيْرُكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَلاَ يُصَلَّى يَوْمَئِذٍ إِلاَّ بِالْمَدِينَةِ، وَكَانُوا يُصَلُّونَ فِيمَا بَيْنَ أَنْ يَغِيبَ الشَّفَقُ إِلَى ثُلُثِ اللَّيْلِ الأَوَّلِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: `Aisha said, "Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delayed the `Isha' prayer till `Umar reminded him by saying, "The prayer!" The women and children have slept. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) came out and said, 'None amongst the dwellers of the earth has been waiting for it (the prayer) except you." `Urwa said, "Nowhere except in Medina the prayer used to be offered (in those days)." He further said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer the `Isha' prayer in the period between the disappearance of the twilight and the end of the first third of the night."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 46; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 544

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودٌ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شُغِلَ عَنْهَا لَيْلَةً، فَأَخَّرَهَا حَتَّى رَقَدْنَا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظْنَا ثُمَّ رَقَدْنَا ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظْنَا، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ يَنْتَظِرُ الصَّلاَةَ غَيْرُكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ لاَ يُبَالِي أَقَدَّمَهَا أَمْ أَخَّرَهَا إِذَا كَانَ لاَ يَخْشَى أَنْ يَغْلِبَهُ النَّوْمُ عَنْ وَقْتِهَا، وَكَانَ يَرْقُدُ قَبْلَهَا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ قُلْتُ لِعَطَاءٍ وَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ، يَقُولُ أَعْتَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةً بِالْعِشَاءِ حَتَّى رَقَدَ النَّاسُ وَاسْتَيْقَظُوا، وَرَقَدُوا وَاسْتَيْقَظُوا، فَقَامَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ الصَّلاَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ عَطَاءٌ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَخَرَجَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ الآنَ، يَقْطُرُ رَأْسُهُ مَاءً، وَاضِعًا يَدَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْلاَ أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي لأَمَرْتُهُمْ أَنْ يُصَلُّوهَا هَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَاسْتَثْبَتُّ عَطَاءً كَيْفَ وَضَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى رَأْسِهِ يَدَهُ كَمَا أَنْبَأَهُ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، فَبَدَّدَ لِي عَطَاءٌ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِهِ شَيْئًا مِنْ تَبْدِيدٍ، ثُمَّ وَضَعَ أَطْرَافَ أَصَابِعِهِ عَلَى قَرْنِ الرَّأْسِ ثُمَّ ضَمَّهَا، يُمِرُّهَا كَذَلِكَ عَلَى الرَّأْسِ حَتَّى مَسَّتْ إِبْهَامُهُ طَرَفَ الأُذُنِ مِمَّا يَلِي الْوَجْهَ عَلَى الصُّدْغِ، وَنَاحِيَةِ اللِّحْيَةِ، لاَ يُقَصِّرُ وَلاَ يَبْطُشُ إِلاَّ كَذَلِكَ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْلاَ أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي لأَمَرْتُهُمْ أَنْ يُصَلُّوا هَكَذَا
Hadith_List.Matn_English: `Abdullah bin `Umar said, "Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was busy (at the time of the `Isha'), so the prayer was delayed so much so that we slept and woke up and slept and woke up again. The Prophet (ﷺ) came out and said, 'None amongst the dwellers of the earth but you have been waiting for the prayer." Ibn `Umar did not find any harm in praying it earlier or in delaying it unless he was afraid that sleep might overwhelm him and he might miss the prayer, and sometimes he used to sleep before the `Isha' prayer. Ibn Juraij said, "I said to `Ata', 'I heard Ibn `Abbas saying: Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delayed the `Isha' prayer to such an extent that the people slept and got up and slept again and got up again. Then `Umar bin Al-Khattab I, stood up and reminded the Prophet (ﷺ) I of the prayer.' `Ata' said, 'Ibn `Abbas said: The Prophet came out as if I was looking at him at this time, and water was trickling from his head and he was putting his hand on his head and then said, 'Hadn't I thought it hard for my followers, I would have ordered them to pray (`Isha' prayer) at this time.' I asked `Ata' for further information, how the Prophet had kept his hand on his head as he was told by Ibn `Abbas. `Ata' separated his fingers slightly and put their tips on the side of the head, brought the fingers downwards approximating them till the thumb touched the lobe of the ear at the side of the temple and the beard on the face. He neither slowed nor hurried in this action but he acted like that. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Hadn't I thought it hard for my followers I would have ordered them to pray at this time."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 47; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 545

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب وَقْتِ الْعِشَاءِ إِلَى نِصْفِ اللَّيْلِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Time of the 'Isha prayer is up to the middle of the night
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَقَالَ أَبُو بَرْزَةَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَسْتَحِبُّ تَأْخِيرَهَا.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: And Abu Barza said that the Prophet ﷺ used to prefer to pray 'Isha' late. ​​

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ أَخَّرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَةَ الْعِشَاءِ إِلَى نِصْفِ اللَّيْلِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ قَدْ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: صَلَّى النَّاسُ وَنَامُوا، أَمَا إِنَّكُمْ فِي صَلاَةٍ مَا انْتَظَرْتُمُوهَا ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏‏.‏ وَزَادَ ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدٌ سَمِعَ أَنَسًا كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَبِيصِ خَاتَمِهِ لَيْلَتَئِذٍ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) delayed the `Isha' prayer till midnight and then he offered the prayer and said, "The people prayed and slept but you have been in prayer as long as you have been waiting for it (the prayer)." Anas added: As if I am looking now at the glitter of the ring of the Prophet (ﷺ) on that night.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 48; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 546

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب فَضْلِ صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Superiority of the Fajr (early morning) prayer

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ، حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ ، قَالَ لِي جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ كُنَّا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ نَظَرَ إِلَى الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَمَا إِنَّكُمْ سَتَرَوْنَ رَبَّكُمْ كَمَا تَرَوْنَ هَذَا، لاَ تُضَامُّونَ ـ أَوْ لاَ تُضَاهُونَ ـ فِي رُؤْيَتِهِ، فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ تُغْلَبُوا عَلَى صَلاَةٍ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ، وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا فَافْعَلُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) on a full moon night. He looked at the moon and said, "You will certainly see your Lord as you see this moon, and there will be no trouble in seeing Him. So if you can avoid missing (through sleep, business, etc.) a prayer before the rising of the sun (Fajr) and before its setting (`Asr) you must do so. He (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) then recited the following verse: And celebrate the praises Of Your Lord before The rising of the sun And before (its) setting." (50.39)
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 49; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 547

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو جَمْرَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: مَنْ صَلَّى الْبَرْدَيْنِ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَجَاءٍ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَمْرَةَ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ بِهَذَا‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ ، عَنْ حَبَّانَ ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَمْرَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ
Hadith_List.Narrator_English: Narrated Abu Bakr bin Abi Musa:
Hadith_List.Matn_English: My father said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever prays the two cool prayers (`Asr and Fajr) will go to Paradise.' "
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 50; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 548

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب وَقْتِ الْفَجْرِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Time of the Fajr (early morning) prayer

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُمْ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: ، تَسَحَّرُوا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَامُوا إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ‏.‏ قُلْتُ كَمْ بَيْنَهُمَا قَالَ قَدْرُ خَمْسِينَ أَوْ سِتِّينَ ـ يَعْنِي آيَةً
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Zaid bin Thabit said, "We took the "Suhur" (the meal taken before dawn while fasting is observed) with the Prophet (ﷺ) and then stood up for the (morning) prayer." I asked him how long the interval between the two (Suhur and prayer) was. He replied, 'The interval between the two was just sufficient to recite fifty to Sixth 'Ayat."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 51; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 549

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَبَّاحٍ ، سَمِعَ رَوْحًا ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَزَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: تَسَحَّرَا، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَا مِنْ سَحُورِهِمَا قَامَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ فَصَلَّى‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: قُلْنَا لأَنَسٍ كَمْ كَانَ بَيْنَ فَرَاغِهِمَا مِنْ سَحُورِهِمَا وَدُخُولِهِمَا فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ قَدْرُ مَا يَقْرَأُ الرَّجُلُ خَمْسِينَ آيَةً
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Anas bin Malik said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) and Zaid bin Thabit took the 'Suhur' together and after finishing the meal, the Prophet (ﷺ) stood up and prayed (Fajr prayer)." I asked Anas, "How long was the interval between finishing their 'Suhur' and starting the prayer?" He replied, "The interval between the two was just sufficient to recite fifty 'Ayat." (Verses of the Qur'an).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 52; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 550

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي أُوَيْسٍ ، عَنْ أَخِيهِ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ ، يَقُولُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: كُنْتُ أَتَسَحَّرُ فِي أَهْلِي ثُمَّ يَكُونُ سُرْعَةٌ بِي أَنْ أُدْرِكَ صَلاَةَ الْفَجْرِ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I used to take the "Suhur" meal with my family and hasten so as to catch the Fajr (morning prayer) with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 53; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 551

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ قَالَتْ،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: كُنَّ نِسَاءُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَشْهَدْنَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَةَ الْفَجْرِ مُتَلَفِّعَاتٍ بِمُرُوطِهِنَّ، ثُمَّ يَنْقَلِبْنَ إِلَى بُيُوتِهِنَّ حِينَ يَقْضِينَ الصَّلاَةَ، لاَ يَعْرِفُهُنَّ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْغَلَسِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The believing women covered with their veiling sheets used to attend the Fajr prayer with Allah's Apostle, and after finishing the prayer they would return to their home and nobody could recognize them because of darkness.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 54; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 552

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ رَكْعَةً
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Whoever got (or was able to offer) one Rak'a of the Fajr prayer (in time). [One Rak'a means, one standing, one bowing, and two prostrations].

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ ، وَعَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، وَعَنِ الأَعْرَجِ ، يُحَدِّثُونَهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الصُّبْحِ رَكْعَةً قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ الصُّبْحَ، وَمَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنَ الْعَصْرِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ الْعَصْرَ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever could get one rak`a (of the Fajr prayer) before sunrise, he has got the (morning) prayer and whoever could get one rak`a of the `Asr prayer before sunset, he has got the (`Asr) prayer."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 55; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 553

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ رَكْعَةً
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Whoever got (or was able to offer) one Rak'a of a prayer (in time)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ الصَّلاَةَ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever could get one rak`a of a prayer, (in its proper time) he has got the prayer."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 56; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 554

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَرْتَفِعَ الشَّمْسُ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: What is said regarding the offering of As-Salat (the prayers) between the Fajr prayer and sunrise.

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، قَالَ شَهِدَ عِنْدِي رِجَالٌ مَرْضِيُّونَ وَأَرْضَاهُمْ عِنْدِي عُمَرُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الصُّبْحِ حَتَّى تَشْرُقَ الشَّمْسُ، وَبَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْعَالِيَةِ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي نَاسٌ، بِهَذَا
Hadith_List.Matn_English: "The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade praying after the Fajr prayer till the sun rises and after the `Asr prayer till the sun sets." Narrated Ibn `Abbas: Some people told me the same narration (as above).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 57; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 555

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا طَلَعَ حَاجِبُ الشَّمْسِ فَأَخِّرُوا الصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى تَرْتَفِعَ، وَإِذَا غَابَ حَاجِبُ الشَّمْسِ فَأَخِّرُوا الصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى تَغِيبَ ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: وَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Ibn `Umar said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Do not pray at the time of sunrise and at the time of sunset.' " Ibn `Umar said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'If the edge of the sun appears (above the horizon) delay the prayer till it becomes high, and if the edge of the sun disappears, delay the prayer till it sets (disappears completely).' "
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 58; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 557

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ، عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعَتَيْنِ وَعَنْ لِبْسَتَيْنِ وَعَنْ صَلاَتَيْنِ نَهَى عَنِ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ، وَبَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ، وَعَنِ اشْتِمَالِ الصَّمَّاءِ وَعَنْ الاِحْتِبَاءِ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ يُفْضِي بِفَرْجِهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ، وَعَنِ الْمُنَابَذَةِ وَالْمُلاَمَسَةِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade two kinds of sales, two kinds of dresses, and two prayers. He forbade offering prayers after the Fajr prayer till the rising of the sun and after the `Asr prayer till its setting. He also forbade "Ishtimal-Assama [??] " and "al-Ihtiba" in one garment in such a way that one's private parts are exposed towards the sky. He also forbade the sales called "Munabadha" and "Mulamasa." (See Hadith No. 354 and 355 Vol. 3).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 59; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 558

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب لاَ يَتَحَرَّى الصَّلاَةَ قَبْلَ غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: One should not try to offer As-Salat (the prayers) just before sunset

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: لاَ يَتَحَرَّى أَحَدُكُمْ فَيُصَلِّي عِنْدَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَلاَ عِنْدَ غُرُوبِهَا ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "None of you should try to pray at sunrise or sunset."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 60; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 559

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْجُنْدَعِيُّ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: لاَ صَلاَةَ بَعْدَ الصُّبْحِ حَتَّى تَرْتَفِعَ الشَّمْسُ، وَلاَ صَلاَةَ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغِيبَ الشَّمْسُ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "There is no prayer after the morning prayer till the sun rises, and there is no prayer after the `Asr prayer till the sun sets."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 61; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 560

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبَانَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ حُمْرَانَ بْنَ أَبَانَ ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ ، قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ لَتُصَلُّونَ صَلاَةً، لَقَدْ صَحِبْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَا رَأَيْنَاهُ يُصَلِّيهَا، وَلَقَدْ نَهَى عَنْهُمَا، يَعْنِي
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: You offer a prayer which I did not see being offered by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when we were in his company and he certainly had forbidden it (i.e. two rak`at after the `Asr prayer).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 62; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 561

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ خُبَيْبٍ ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: صَلاَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ، وَبَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the offering of two prayers: -1. after the morning prayer till the sunrises. -2. after the `Asr prayer till the sun sets.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 63; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 562

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَنْ لَمْ يَكْرَهِ الصَّلاَةَ إِلاَّ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ وَالْفَجْرِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Whoever did not dislike to offer optional prayers except after the compulsory prayers of 'Asr and Fajr only
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: رَوَاهُ عُمَرُ وَابْنُ عُمَرَ وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ وَأَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: This has been narrated by 'Umar, Ibn 'Umar, Abu Sa'id and Abu Hurairah. ​​

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ أُصَلِّي كَمَا رَأَيْتُ أَصْحَابِي يُصَلُّونَ،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: لاَ أَنْهَى أَحَدًا يُصَلِّي بِلَيْلٍ وَلاَ نَهَارٍ مَا شَاءَ، غَيْرَ أَنْ لاَ تَحَرَّوْا طُلُوعَ الشَّمْسِ وَلاَ غُرُوبَهَا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I pray as I saw my companions praying. I do not forbid praying at any time during the day or night except at sunset and sunrise.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 64; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 563

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَا يُصَلَّى بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ مِنَ الْفَوَائِتِ وَنَحْوِهَا
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To offer the missed Salat (prayers) and the like after the 'Asr prayer
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَقَالَ كُرَيْبٌ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَقَالَ: «شَغَلَنِي نَاسٌ مِنْ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ».
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: And narrated Umm Salama رضي الله عنها: The Prophet ﷺ offered two Rak'a after the 'Asr prayer and said, "Some people of the tribe of 'Abdul-Qais made me busy and did not let me offer the two Rak'a after the Zuhr prayer." ​​

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ أَيْمَنَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ وَالَّذِي ذَهَبَ بِهِ مَا تَرَكَهُمَا حَتَّى لَقِيَ اللَّهَ، وَمَا لَقِيَ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى حَتَّى ثَقُلَ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ، وَكَانَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يُصَلِّي كَثِيرًا مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ قَاعِدًا ـ تَعْنِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ ـ وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّيهِمَا، وَلاَ يُصَلِّيهِمَا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ يُثَقِّلَ عَلَى أُمَّتِهِ، وَكَانَ يُحِبُّ مَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: By Allah, Who took away the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) never missed them (two rak`at) after the `Asr prayer till he met Allah and he did not meet Allah till it became heavy for him to pray while standing so he used to offer most of the prayers while sitting. (She meant the two rak`at after `Asr) He used to pray them in the house and never prayed them in the mosque lest it might be hard for his followers and he loved what was easy for them .
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 65; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 564

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي قَالَتْ، عَائِشَةُ ابْنَ أُخْتِي
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: مَا تَرَكَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم السَّجْدَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ عِنْدِي قَطُّ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: `Aisha (addressing me) said, "O son of my sister! The Prophet (ﷺ) never missed two prostrations (i.e. rak`at) after the `Asr prayer in my house."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 66; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 565

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الشَّيْبَانِيُّ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الأَسْوَدِ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: رَكْعَتَانِ لَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَعُهُمَا سِرًّا وَلاَ عَلاَنِيَةً رَكْعَتَانِ قَبْلَ صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ، وَرَكْعَتَانِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never missed two rak`at before the Fajr prayer and after the `Asr prayer openly and secretly.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 67; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 566

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ الأَسْوَدَ وَمَسْرُوقًا شَهِدَا عَلَى عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: مَا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْتِينِي فِي يَوْمٍ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ إِلاَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) come to me after the `Asr prayer, he always prayed two rak`at.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 68; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 567

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب التَّبْكِيرِ بِالصَّلاَةِ فِي يَوْمِ غَيْمٍ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To offer (the 'Asr prayers) earlier on a cloudy day

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى ـ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ ـ عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ ، أَنَّ أَبَا الْمَلِيحِ ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ بُرَيْدَةَ فِي يَوْمٍ ذِي غَيْمٍ فَقَالَ بَكِّرُوا بِالصَّلاَةِ فَإِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: مَنْ تَرَكَ صَلاَةَ الْعَصْرِ حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: I was with Buraida on a cloudy day and he said, "Offer the `Asr prayer earlier as the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever leaves the `Asr prayer will have all his (good) deeds annulled." (See Hadith No. 527 and 528)
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 69; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 568

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الأَذَانِ بَعْدَ ذَهَابِ الْوَقْتِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The Adhan for the Salat (prayer) after its stated time is over

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ سِرْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةً فَقَالَ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ لَوْ عَرَّسْتَ بِنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَخَافُ أَنْ تَنَامُوا عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ بِلاَلٌ أَنَا أُوقِظُكُمْ‏.‏ فَاضْطَجَعُوا وَأَسْنَدَ بِلاَلٌ ظَهْرَهُ إِلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ، فَغَلَبَتْهُ عَيْنَاهُ فَنَامَ، فَاسْتَيْقَظَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ طَلَعَ حَاجِبُ الشَّمْسِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا بِلاَلُ أَيْنَ مَا قُلْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ مَا أُلْقِيَتْ عَلَىَّ نَوْمَةٌ مِثْلُهَا قَطُّ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَبَضَ أَرْوَاحَكُمْ حِينَ شَاءَ، وَرَدَّهَا عَلَيْكُمْ حِينَ شَاءَ، يَا بِلاَلُ قُمْ فَأَذِّنْ بِالنَّاسِ بِالصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَتَوَضَّأَ فَلَمَّا ارْتَفَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَابْيَاضَّتْ قَامَ فَصَلَّى‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: My father said, "One night we were traveling with the Prophet (ﷺ) and some people said, 'We wish that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would take a rest along with us during the last hours of the night.' He said, 'I am afraid that you will sleep and miss the (Fajr) prayer.' Bilal said, 'I will make you get up.' So all slept and Bilal rested his back against his Rahila and he too was overwhelmed (by sleep) and slept. The Prophet (ﷺ) got up when the edge of the sun had risen and said, 'O Bilal! What about your statement?' He replied, 'I have never slept such a sleep.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Allah captured your souls when He wished, and released them when He wished. O Bilal! Get up and pronounce the Adhan for the prayer.' The Prophet (ﷺ) performed ablution and when the sun came up and became bright, he stood up and prayed."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 70; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 569

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَنْ صَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ جَمَاعَةً بَعْدَ ذَهَابِ الْوَقْتِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Whoever led the people in Salat (prayer) after its time was over

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، جَاءَ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ بَعْدَ مَا غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ، فَجَعَلَ يَسُبُّ كُفَّارَ قُرَيْشٍ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا كِدْتُ أُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ حَتَّى كَادَتِ الشَّمْسُ تَغْرُبُ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَاللَّهِ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: مَا صَلَّيْتُهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُمْنَا إِلَى بُطْحَانَ، فَتَوَضَّأَ لِلصَّلاَةِ، وَتَوَضَّأْنَا لَهَا فَصَلَّى الْعَصْرَ بَعْدَ مَا غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى بَعْدَهَا الْمَغْرِبَ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: On the day of Al-Khandaq (the battle of trench.) `Umar bin Al-Khattab came cursing the disbelievers of Quraish after the sun had set and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I could not offer the `Asr prayer till the sun had set." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "By Allah! I, too, have not prayed." So we turned towards Buthan, and the Prophet (ﷺ) performed ablution and we too performed ablution and offered the `Asr prayer after the sun had set, and then he offered the Maghrib prayer.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 71; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 570

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَنْ نَسِيَ صَلاَةً فَلْيُصَلِّ إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا وَلاَ يُعِيدُ إِلاَّ تِلْكَ الصَّلاَةَ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: One who forgets a Salat (prayer) should offer it when he remembers it, and should not repeat anything except that particular prayer
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ مَنْ تَرَكَ صَلاَةً وَاحِدَةً عِشْرِينَ سَنَةً لَمْ يُعِدْ إِلاَّ تِلْكَ الصَّلاَةَ الْوَاحِدَةَ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: Ibrahim said: If one missed unintentionally one prayer 20 years ago then he should offer only that Salat (prayer). ​​

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، وَمُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: مَنْ نَسِيَ صَلاَةً فَلْيُصَلِّ إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا، لاَ كَفَّارَةَ لَهَا إِلاَّ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ‏‏ {‏وَأَقِمِ الصَّلاَةَ لِذِكْرِي‏} ‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: قَالَ مُوسَى قَالَ هَمَّامٌ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ بَعْدُ ‏‏ {‏وَأَقِمِ الصَّلاَةَ لِذِكْرِي‏} ‏‏.‏وَقَالَ حَبَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَهُ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone forgets a prayer he should pray that prayer when he remembers it. There is no expiation except to pray the same." Then he recited: "Establish prayer for My (i.e. Allah's) remembrance." (20.14).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 72; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 571

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب قَضَاءِ الصَّلَوَاتِ الأُولَى فَالأُولَى
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The Qada of prayers (Qada means to perform or offer or do a missed religious obligation after its stated time)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ـ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ ـ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، قَالَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: جَعَلَ عُمَرُ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ يَسُبُّ كُفَّارَهُمْ وَقَالَ مَا كِدْتُ أُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ حَتَّى غَرَبَتْ‏.‏ قَالَ فَنَزَلْنَا بُطْحَانَ، فَصَلَّى بَعْدَ مَا غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: `Umar came cursing the disbelievers (of Quraish) on the day of Al-Khandaq (the battle of Trench) and said, "I could not offer the `Asr prayer till the sun had set. Then we went to Buthan and he offered the (`Asr) prayer after sunset and then he offered the Maghrib prayer.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 73; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 572

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَا يُكْرَهُ مِنَ السَّمَرِ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: What is disliked about talking after the 'Isha prayer

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَوْفٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمِنْهَالِ ، قَالَ انْطَلَقْتُ مَعَ أَبِي إِلَى أَبِي بَرْزَةَ الأَسْلَمِيِّ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبِي حَدِّثْنَا كَيْفَ، كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي الْمَكْتُوبَةَ قَالَ كَانَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يُصَلِّي الْهَجِيرَ وَهْىَ الَّتِي تَدْعُونَهَا الأُولَى حِينَ تَدْحَضُ الشَّمْسُ، وَيُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ، ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ أَحَدُنَا إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فِي أَقْصَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَالشَّمْسُ حَيَّةٌ، وَنَسِيتُ مَا قَالَ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ يَسْتَحِبُّ أَنْ يُؤَخِّرَ الْعِشَاءَ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ يَكْرَهُ النَّوْمَ قَبْلَهَا وَالْحَدِيثَ بَعْدَهَا، وَكَانَ يَنْفَتِلُ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الْغَدَاةِ حِينَ يَعْرِفُ أَحَدُنَا جَلِيسَهُ، وَيَقْرَأُ مِنَ السِّتِّينَ إِلَى الْمِائَةِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: My father and I went to Abi Barza Al-Aslami and my father said to him, "Tell us how Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer the compulsory congregational prayers." He said, "He used to pray the Zuhr prayer, which you call the first prayer, as the sun declined at noon, the `Asr at a time when one of US could go to his family at the farthest place in Medina while the sun was still hot. (The narrator forgot what Abu Barza had said about the Maghrib prayer), and the Prophet (ﷺ) preferred to pray the `Isha' late and disliked to sleep before it or talk after it. And he used to return after finishing the morning prayer at such a time when it was possible for one to recognize the person sitting by his side and he (the Prophet) used to recite 60 to 100 'Ayat' (verses) of the Qur'an in it."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 74; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 573

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب السَّمَرِ فِي الْفِقْهِ وَالْخَيْرِ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Talking about the Islamic jurisprudence and good things after the 'Isha prayer

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الْحَنَفِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ ، قَالَ انْتَظَرْنَا الْحَسَنَ وَرَاثَ عَلَيْنَا حَتَّى قَرُبْنَا مِنْ وَقْتِ قِيَامِهِ، فَجَاءَ فَقَالَ دَعَانَا جِيرَانُنَا هَؤُلاَءِ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسٌ نَ ظَرْنَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ حَتَّى كَانَ شَطْرُ اللَّيْلِ يَبْلُغُهُ، فَجَاءَ فَصَلَّى لَنَا، ثُمَّ خَطَبَنَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَلاَ إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ صَلَّوْا ثُمَّ رَقَدُوا، وَإِنَّكُمْ لَمْ تَزَالُوا فِي صَلاَةٍ مَا انْتَظَرْتُمُ الصَّلاَةَ ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏‏.‏ قَالَ الْحَسَنُ وَإِنَّ الْقَوْمَ لاَ يَزَالُونَ بِخَيْرٍ مَا انْتَظَرُوا الْخَيْرَ‏.‏ قَالَ قُرَّةُ هُوَ مِنْ حَدِيثِ أَنَسٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Once he waited for Al-Hasan and he did not show up till it was about the usual time for him to start his speech; then he came and apologized saying, "Our neighbors invited us." Then he added, "Narrated Anas, 'Once we waited for the Prophet (ﷺ) till it was midnight or about midnight. He came and led the prayer, and after finishing it, he addressed us and said, 'All the people prayed and then slept and you had been in prayer as long as you were waiting for it." Al-Hasan said, "The people are regarded as performing good deeds as long as they are waiting for doing good deeds." Al-Hasan's statement is a portion of Anas's [??] Hadith from the Prophet (ﷺ) .
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 75; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 574

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَةَ الْعِشَاءِ فِي آخِرِ حَيَاتِهِ، فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أَرَأَيْتَكُمْ لَيْلَتَكُمْ هَذِهِ فَإِنَّ رَأْسَ مِائَةٍ لاَ يَبْقَى مِمَّنْ هُوَ الْيَوْمَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الأَرْضِ أَحَدٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَوَهِلَ النَّاسُ فِي مَقَالَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ـ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ـ إِلَى مَا يَتَحَدَّثُونَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الأَحَادِيثِ عَنْ مِائَةِ سَنَةٍ، وَإِنَّمَا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَبْقَى مِمَّنْ هُوَ الْيَوْمَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الأَرْضِ ‏"‏ يُرِيدُ بِذَلِكَ أَنَّهَا تَخْرِمُ ذَلِكَ الْقَرْنَ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed one of the `Isha' prayer in his last days and after finishing it with Taslim, he stood up and said, "Do you realize (the importance of) this night? Nobody present on the surface of the earth tonight would be living after the completion of one hundred years from this night." The people made a mistake in grasping the meaning of this statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and they indulged in those things which are said about these narrators (i.e. some said that the Day of Resurrection will be established after 100 years etc.) But the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Nobody present on the surface of earth tonight would be living after the completion of 100 years from this night"; he meant "When that century (people of that century) would pass away."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 76; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 575

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب السَّمَرِ مَعَ الضَّيْفِ وَالأَهْلِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To talk with the family and the guests after the 'sha prayer.

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ، أَنَّ أَصْحَابَ الصُّفَّةِ، كَانُوا أُنَاسًا فُقَرَاءَ، وَأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: مَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ طَعَامُ اثْنَيْنِ فَلْيَذْهَبْ بِثَالِثٍ، وَإِنْ أَرْبَعٌ فَخَامِسٌ أَوْ سَادِسٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ جَاءَ بِثَلاَثَةٍ فَانْطَلَقَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعَشَرَةٍ، قَالَ فَهْوَ أَنَا وَأَبِي وَأُمِّي، فَلاَ أَدْرِي قَالَ وَامْرَأَتِي وَخَادِمٌ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ بَيْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ‏.‏ وَإِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ تَعَشَّى عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ لَبِثَ حَيْثُ صُلِّيَتِ الْعِشَاءُ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَلَبِثَ حَتَّى تَعَشَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَاءَ بَعْدَ مَا مَضَى مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، قَالَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَتُهُ وَمَا حَبَسَكَ عَنْ أَضْيَافِكَ ـ أَوْ قَالَتْ ضَيْفِكَ ـ قَالَ أَوَمَا عَشَّيْتِيهِمْ قَالَتْ أَبَوْا حَتَّى تَجِيءَ، قَدْ عُرِضُوا فَأَبَوْا‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَهَبْتُ أَنَا فَاخْتَبَأْتُ فَقَالَ يَا غُنْثَرُ، فَجَدَّعَ وَسَبَّ، وَقَالَ كُلُوا لاَ هَنِيئًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَطْعَمُهُ أَبَدًا، وَايْمُ اللَّهِ مَا كُنَّا نَأْخُذُ مِنْ لُقْمَةٍ إِلاَّ رَبَا مِنْ أَسْفَلِهَا أَكْثَرُ مِنْهَا‏.‏ قَالَ يَعْنِي حَتَّى شَبِعُوا وَصَارَتْ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا كَانَتْ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَإِذَا هِيَ كَمَا هِيَ أَوْ أَكْثَرُ مِنْهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ لاِمْرَأَتِهِ يَا أُخْتَ بَنِي فِرَاسٍ مَا هَذَا قَالَتْ لاَ وَقُرَّةِ عَيْنِي لَهِيَ الآنَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْهَا قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ بِثَلاَثِ مَرَّاتٍ‏.‏ فَأَكَلَ مِنْهَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا كَانَ ذَلِكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ ـ يَعْنِي يَمِينَهُ ـ ثُمَّ أَكَلَ مِنْهَا لُقْمَةً، ثُمَّ حَمَلَهَا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَصْبَحَتْ عِنْدَهُ، وَكَانَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمٍ عَقْدٌ، فَمَضَى الأَجَلُ، فَفَرَّقَنَا اثْنَا عَشَرَ رَجُلاً، مَعَ كُلِّ رَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ أُنَاسٌ، اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ كَمْ مَعَ كُلِّ رَجُلٍ فَأَكَلُوا مِنْهَا أَجْمَعُونَ، أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: `Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr said, "The Suffa Companions were poor people and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever has food for two persons should take a third one from them (Suffa companions). And whosoever has food for four persons he should take one or two from them' Abu Bakr took three men and the Prophet (ﷺ) took ten of them." `Abdur Rahman added, my father my mother and I were there (in the house). (The sub-narrator is in doubt whether `Abdur Rahman also said, 'My wife and our servant who was common for both my house and Abu Bakr's house). Abu Bakr took his supper with the Prophet (ﷺ) and remained there till the `Isha' prayer was offered. Abu Bakr went back and stayed with the Prophet (ﷺ) till the Prophet (ﷺ) took his meal and then Abu Bakr returned to his house after a long portion of the night had passed. Abu Bakr's wife said, 'What detained you from your guests (or guest)?' He said, 'Have you not served them yet?' She said, 'They refused to eat until you come. The food was served for them but they refused." `Abdur Rahman added, "I went away and hid myself (being afraid of Abu Bakr) and in the meantime he (Abu Bakr) called me, 'O Ghunthar (a harsh word)!' and also called me bad names and abused me and then said (to his family), 'Eat. No welcome for you.' Then (the supper was served). Abu Bakr took an oath that he would not eat that food. The narrator added: By Allah, whenever any one of us (myself and the guests of Suffa companions) took anything from the food, it increased from underneath. We all ate to our fill and the food was more than it was before its serving. Abu Bakr looked at it (the food) and found it as it was before serving or even more than that. He addressed his wife (saying) 'O the sister of Bani Firas! What is this?' She said, 'O the pleasure of my eyes! The food is now three times more than it was before.' Abu Bakr ate from it, and said, 'That (oath) was from Satan' meaning his oath (not to eat). Then he again took a morsel (mouthful) from it and then took the rest of it to the Prophet. So that meal was with the Prophet. There was a treaty between us and some people, and when the period of that treaty had elapsed the Prophet (ﷺ) divided us into twelve (groups) (the Prophet's companions) each being headed by a man. Allah knows how many men were under the command of each (leader). So all of them (12 groups of men) ate of that meal."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 9, Hadith 77; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 10, Hadith 576

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب بَدْءُ الأَذَانِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: How the Adhan for Salat (Prayer) was started
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَقَوْلُهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: {وَإِذَا نَادَيْتُمْ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ اتَّخَذُوهَا هُزُوًا وَلَعِبًا ذَلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لاَ يَعْقِلُونَ} وَقَوْلُهُ: {إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلاَةِ مِنْ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ}.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: And the Statement of Allah جل جلاله: "And when you proclaim the call for As-Salat [call for the prayer (Adhan)], they take it (but) as a mockery and fun; that is because they are a people who understand not." (V.5:58). And also the Statement of Allah تعالى: "...When the call (Adhan) is proclaimed for the Salat (prayer) on the day of Friday..." (V.62:9).

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ ذَكَرُوا النَّارَ وَالنَّاقُوسَ، فَذَكَرُوا الْيَهُودَ وَالنَّصَارَى، فَأُمِرَ بِلاَلٌ أَنْ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَشْفَعَ الأَذَانَ وَأَنْ يُوتِرَ الإِقَامَةَ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The people mentioned the fire and the bell (they suggested those as signals to indicate the starting of prayers), and by that they mentioned the Jews and the Christians. Then Bilal was ordered to pronounce Adhan for the prayer by saying its wordings twice, and for the Iqama (the call for the actual standing for the prayers in rows) by saying its wordings once. (Iqama is pronounced when the people are ready for the prayer).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 1; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 577

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ، كَانَ يَقُولُ كَانَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ حِينَ قَدِمُوا الْمَدِينَةَ يَجْتَمِعُونَ فَيَتَحَيَّنُونَ الصَّلاَةَ، لَيْسَ يُنَادَى لَهَا، فَتَكَلَّمُوا يَوْمًا فِي ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ اتَّخِذُوا نَاقُوسًا مِثْلَ نَاقُوسِ النَّصَارَى‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَلْ بُوقًا مِثْلَ قَرْنِ الْيَهُودِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ أَوَلاَ تَبْعَثُونَ رَجُلاً يُنَادِي بِالصَّلاَةِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَا بِلاَلُ قُمْ فَنَادِ بِالصَّلاَةِ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: When the Muslims arrived at Medina, they used to assemble for the prayer, and used to guess the time for it. During those days, the practice of Adhan for the prayers had not been introduced yet. Once they discussed this problem regarding the call for prayer. Some people suggested the use of a bell like the Christians, others proposed a trumpet like the horn used by the Jews, but `Umar was the first to suggest that a man should call (the people) for the prayer; so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered Bilal to get up and pronounce the Adhan for prayers.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 2; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 578

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الأَذَانُ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Pronouncing the wording of Adhan for Salat (prayers) twice (in doubles)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أُمِرَ بِلاَلٌ أَنْ يَشْفَعَ، الأَذَانَ وَأَنْ يُوتِرَ الإِقَامَةَ إِلاَّ الإِقَامَةَ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Bilal was ordered to repeat the wording of the Adhan for prayers twice, and to pronounce the wording of the Iqama once except "Qad-qamat-is-salat".
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 3; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 579

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ، قَالَ لَمَّا كَثُرَ النَّاسُ قَالَ ـ ذَكَرُوا ـ أَنْ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يَعْلَمُوا وَقْتَ الصَّلاَةِ بِشَىْءٍ يَعْرِفُونَهُ، فَذَكَرُوا أَنْ يُورُوا نَارًا أَوْ يَضْرِبُوا نَاقُوسًا، فَأُمِرَ بِلاَلٌ أَنْ يَشْفَعَ الأَذَانَ وَأَنْ يُوتِرَ الإِقَامَةَ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: When the number of Muslims increased they discussed the question as to how to know the time for the prayer by some familiar means. Some suggested that a fire be lit (at the time of the prayer) and others put forward the proposal to ring the bell. Bilal was ordered to pronounce the wording of Adhan twice and of the Iqama once only.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 4; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 580

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الإِقَامَةُ وَاحِدَةٌ، إِلاَّ قَوْلَهُ قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلاَةُ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To pronounce the wording of Iqama once (in singles) except Qad-qamat-is-Salat

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: أُمِرَ بِلاَلٌ أَنْ يَشْفَعَ، الأَذَانَ، وَأَنْ يُوتِرَ الإِقَامَةَ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: قَالَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ فَذَكَرْتُ لأَيُّوبَ فَقَالَ إِلاَّ الإِقَامَةَ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Anas said, "Bilal was ordered to pronounce the wording of Adhan twice and of Iqama once only." The sub narrator Isma`il said, "I mentioned that to Aiyub and he added (to that), "Except Iqama (i.e. Qadqamat- is-salat which should be said twice).
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 5; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 581

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب فَضْلِ التَّأْذِينِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Superiority of the Adhan

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلاَةِ أَدْبَرَ الشَّيْطَانُ وَلَهُ ضُرَاطٌ حَتَّى لاَ يَسْمَعَ التَّأْذِينَ، فَإِذَا قَضَى النِّدَاءَ أَقْبَلَ، حَتَّى إِذَا ثُوِّبَ بِالصَّلاَةِ أَدْبَرَ، حَتَّى إِذَا قَضَى التَّثْوِيبَ أَقْبَلَ حَتَّى يَخْطُرَ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَنَفْسِهِ، يَقُولُ اذْكُرْ كَذَا، اذْكُرْ كَذَا‏.‏ لِمَا لَمْ يَكُنْ يَذْكُرُ، حَتَّى يَظَلَّ الرَّجُلُ لاَ يَدْرِي كَمْ صَلَّى ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the Adhan is pronounced Satan takes to his heels and passes wind with noise during his flight in order not to hear the Adhan. When the Adhan is completed he comes back and again takes to his heels when the Iqama is pronounced and after its completion he returns again till he whispers into the heart of the person (to divert his attention from his prayer) and makes him remember things which he does not recall to his mind before the prayer and that causes him to forget how much he has prayed."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 6; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 582

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب رَفْعِ الصَّوْتِ بِالنِّدَاءِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Raising the voice in pronouncing the Adhan
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ أَذِّنْ أَذَانًا سَمْحًا وَإِلاَّ فَاعْتَزِلْنَا.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: 'Umar bin 'Abdul 'Aziz said (to his Mu'adh-dhin i.e., call-maker), "Pronounce the Adhan clearly and in a straightforward manner, otherwise we will dismiss you." ​​

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ ، ثُمَّ الْمَازِنِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ قَالَ لَهُ ‏"‏ إِنِّي أَرَاكَ تُحِبُّ الْغَنَمَ وَالْبَادِيَةَ، فَإِذَا كُنْتَ فِي غَنَمِكَ أَوْ بَادِيَتِكَ فَأَذَّنْتَ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَارْفَعْ صَوْتَكَ بِالنِّدَاءِ، فَإِنَّهُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: لاَ يَسْمَعُ مَدَى صَوْتِ الْمُؤَذِّنِ جِنٌّ وَلاَ إِنْسٌ وَلاَ شَىْءٌ إِلاَّ شَهِدَ لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: ‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri told my father, "I see you liking sheep and the wilderness. So whenever you are with your sheep or in the wilderness and you want to pronounce Adhan for the prayer raise your voice in doing so, for whoever hears the Adhan, whether a human being, a jinn or any other creature, will be a witness for you on the Day of Resurrection." Abu Sa`id added, "I heard it (this narration) from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 7; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 583

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَا يُحْقَنُ بِالأَذَانِ مِنَ الدِّمَاءِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To suspend fighting on hearing the Adhan

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا غَزَا بِنَا قَوْمًا لَمْ يَكُنْ يَغْزُو بِنَا حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ وَيَنْظُرَ، فَإِنْ سَمِعَ أَذَانًا كَفَّ عَنْهُمْ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْ أَذَانًا أَغَارَ عَلَيْهِمْ، قَالَ فَخَرَجْنَا إِلَى خَيْبَرَ فَانْتَهَيْنَا إِلَيْهِمْ لَيْلاً، فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ وَلَمْ يَسْمَعْ أَذَانًا رَكِبَ وَرَكِبْتُ خَلْفَ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، وَإِنَّ قَدَمِي لَتَمَسُّ قَدَمَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالَ فَخَرَجُوا إِلَيْنَا بِمَكَاتِلِهِمْ وَمَسَاحِيهِمْ فَلَمَّا رَأَوُا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالُوا مُحَمَّدٌ وَاللَّهِ، مُحَمَّدٌ وَالْخَمِيسُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا رَآهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، خَرِبَتْ خَيْبَرُ، إِنَّا إِذَا نَزَلْنَا بِسَاحَةِ قَوْمٍ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Anas bin Malik said, "Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) went out with us to fight (in Allah's cause) against any nation, he never allowed us to attack till morning and he would wait and see: if he heard Adhan he would postpone the attack and if he did not hear Adhan he would attack them." Anas added, "We reached Khaibar at night and in the morning when he did not hear the Adhan for the prayer, he (the Prophet ) rode and I rode behind Abi Talha and my foot was touching that of the Prophet. The inhabitants of Khaibar came out with their baskets and spades and when they saw the Prophet (ﷺ) they shouted 'Muhammad! By Allah, Muhammad and his army.' When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw them, he said, "Allahu-Akbar! Allahu-Akbar! Khaibar is ruined. Whenever we approach a (hostile) nation (to fight), then evil will be the morning of those who have been warned."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 8; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 584

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا سَمِعَ الْمُنَادِي
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: What to say on hearing the Adhan

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمُ النِّدَاءَ فَقُولُوا مِثْلَ ما يَقُولُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whenever you hear the Adhan, say what the Mu'adh-dhin is saying.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 9; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 585

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عِيسَى بْنُ طَلْحَةَ ، أَنَّهُ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: سَمِعَ مُعَاوِيَةَ ، يَوْمًا فَقَالَ مِثْلَهُ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ رَاهَوَيْهِ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى ، نَحْوَهُ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: that he had heard Muawiya repeating the words of Adhan up to "Wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan rasulul-lah (and I testify that Muhammad is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).)"
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 10; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 586

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: قَالَ يَحْيَى وَحَدَّثَنِي بَعْضُ، إِخْوَانِنَا أَنَّهُ قَالَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: لَمَّا قَالَ حَىَّ عَلَى الصَّلاَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: وَقَالَ هَكَذَا سَمِعْنَا نَبِيَّكُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ
Hadith_List.Narrator_English: Narrated Yahya as above (586) and added:
Hadith_List.Matn_English: "Some of my companions told me that Hisham had said, "When the Mu'adh-dhin said, "Haiyi `alassala (come for the prayer)." Muawiya said, "La hawla wala quwata illa billah (There is neither might nor any power except with Allah)" and added, "We heard your Prophet saying the same."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 11; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 587

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الدُّعَاءِ عِنْدَ النِّدَاءِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Invocation at the time of Adhan

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يَسْمَعُ النِّدَاءَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلاَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، حَلَّتْ لَهُ شَفَاعَتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever after listening to the Adhan says, 'Allahumma Rabba hadhihi-dda` watit-tammah, was-salatil qa'imah, ati Muhammadan al-wasilata wal-fadilah, wa b`ath-hu maqaman mahmudan-il-ladhi wa`adtahu' [O Allah! Lord of this perfect call (perfect by not ascribing partners to You) and of the regular prayer which is going to be established, give Muhammad the right of intercession and illustriousness, and resurrect him to the best and the highest place in Paradise that You promised him (of)], then my intercession for him will be allowed on the Day of Resurrection".
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 12; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 588

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الاِسْتِهَامِ فِي الأَذَانِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: To draw lots for pronouncing the Adhan
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَيُذْكَرُ أَنَّ أَقْوَامًا اخْتَلَفُوا فِي الأَذَانِ فَأَقْرَعَ بَيْنَهُمْ سَعْدٌ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: And it is said that some people differed regarding the pronunciation of Adhan (i.e., who should pronounce the Adhan). So Sa'd drew lots amongst them. ​​

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ النَّاسُ مَا فِي النِّدَاءِ وَالصَّفِّ الأَوَّلِ، ثُمَّ لَمْ يَجِدُوا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَسْتَهِمُوا عَلَيْهِ لاَسْتَهَمُوا، وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِي التَّهْجِيرِ لاَسْتَبَقُوا إِلَيْهِ، وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِي الْعَتَمَةِ وَالصُّبْحِ لأَتَوْهُمَا وَلَوْ حَبْوًا ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If the people knew the reward for pronouncing the Adhan and for standing in the first row (in congregational prayers) and found no other way to get that except by drawing lots they would draw lots, and if they knew the reward of the Zuhr prayer (in the early moments of its stated time) they would race for it (go early) and if they knew the reward of `Isha' and Fajr (morning) prayers in congregation, they would come to offer them even if they had to crawl."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 13; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 589

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الْكَلاَمِ فِي الأَذَانِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: Talking during the Adhan
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_Arabic: وَتَكَلَّمَ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ صُرَدٍ فِي أَذَانِهِ. وَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ لاَ بَأْسَ أَنْ يَضْحَكَ وَهْوَ يُؤَذِّنُ أَوْ يُقِيمُ.
Chapters.Chapter_Intro_English: Sulaiman bin Surad talked while pronouncing Adhan. Al-Hasan said, "There is no harm if the Mu'adh-dhin laughs while pronouncing the Adhan or Iqama." ​​

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ ، وَعَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، صَاحِبِ الزِّيَادِيِّ وَعَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ قَالَ خَطَبَنَا ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فِي يَوْمٍ رَدْغٍ،
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ حَىَّ عَلَى الصَّلاَةِ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُنَادِيَ الصَّلاَةُ فِي الرِّحَالِ‏.‏ فَنَظَرَ الْقَوْمُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَى بَعْضٍ فَقَالَ فَعَلَ هَذَا مَنْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنْهُ وَإِنَّهَا عَزْمَةٌ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Once on a rainy muddy day, Ibn `Abbas delivered a sermon in our presence and when the Mu'adhdhin pronounced the Adhan and said, "Haiyi `ala-s-sala(t) (come for the prayer)" Ibn `Abbas ordered him to say 'Pray at your homes.' The people began to look at each other (surprisingly). Ibn `Abbas said. "It was done by one who was much better than I (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) or his Mu'adh-dhin), and it is a license.'
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 14; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 590

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب أَذَانِ الأَعْمَى إِذَا كَانَ لَهُ مَنْ يُخْبِرُهُ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The Adhan pronounced by a blind man (is permissible) when there is a person to inform him about the time of the Salat (prayer)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: بِلاَلاً يُؤَذِّنُ بِلَيْلٍ، فَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى يُنَادِيَ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ وَكَانَ رَجُلاً أَعْمَى لاَ يُنَادِي حَتَّى يُقَالَ لَهُ أَصْبَحْتَ أَصْبَحْتَ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: My father said that Allah s Apostle said, "Bilal pronounces 'Adhan at night, so keep on eating and drinking (Suhur) till Ibn Um Maktum pronounces Adhan." Salim added, "He was a blind man who would not pronounce the Adhan unless he was told that the day had dawned."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 15; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 591

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الأَذَانِ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The Adhan after Al-Fajr (dawn)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَتْنِي حَفْصَةُ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِذَا اعْتَكَفَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ لِلصُّبْحِ وَبَدَا الصُّبْحُ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُقَامَ الصَّلاَةُ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: When the Mu'adh-dhin pronounced the Adhan for Fajr prayer and the dawn became evident the Prophet ordered a two rak`at light prayer (Sunna) before the Iqama of the compulsory (congregational) prayer.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 16; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 592

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ بَيْنَ النِّدَاءِ وَالإِقَامَةِ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ‏.‏
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer two light rak`at between the Adhan and the Iqama of the Fajr prayer.
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 17; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 593

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِنَّ بِلاَلاً يُنَادِي بِلَيْلٍ، فَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى يُنَادِيَ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Bilal pronounces the Adhan at night, so keep on eating and drinking (Suhur) till Ibn Um Maktum pronounces the Adhan."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 18; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 594

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب الأَذَانِ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: The Adhan before Al-Fajr (dawn)

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: لاَ يَمْنَعَنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ ـ أَوْ أَحَدًا مِنْكُمْ ـ أَذَانُ بِلاَلٍ مِنْ سَحُورِهِ، فَإِنَّهُ يُؤَذِّنُ ـ أَوْ يُنَادِي ـ بِلَيْلٍ، لِيَرْجِعَ قَائِمَكُمْ وَلِيُنَبِّهَ نَائِمَكُمْ، وَلَيْسَ أَنْ يَقُولَ الْفَجْرُ أَوِ الصُّبْحُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ بِأَصَابِعِهِ وَرَفَعَهَا إِلَى فَوْقُ وَطَأْطَأَ إِلَى أَسْفَلُ حَتَّى يَقُولَ هَكَذَا‏.‏
Hadith_List.Rest_Arabic: وَقَالَ زُهَيْرٌ بِسَبَّابَتَيْهِ إِحْدَاهُمَا فَوْقَ الأُخْرَى ثُمَّ مَدَّهَا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَشِمَالِهِ
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Adhan pronounced by Bilal should not stop you from taking Suhur, for he pronounces the Adhan at night, so that the one offering the late night prayer (Tahajjud) from among you might hurry up and the sleeping from among you might wake up. It does not mean that dawn or morning has started." Then he (the Prophet) pointed with his fingers and raised them up (towards the sky) and then lowered them (towards the earth) like this (Ibn Mas`ud imitated the gesture of the Prophet). Az-Zuhri gestured with his two index fingers which he put on each other and then stretched them to the right and left. These gestures illustrate the way real dawn appears. It spreads left and right horizontally. The dawn that appears in the high sky and lowers down is not the real dawn) .
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 19; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 595

Hadith_List.Isnad_Arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ ، قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ،‏.‏ وَعَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ‏.‏ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي يُوسُفُ بْنُ عِيسَى الْمَرْوَزِيُّ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏
Hadith_List.Matn_Arabic: إِنَّ بِلاَلاً يُؤَذِّنُ بِلَيْلٍ، فَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى يُؤَذِّنَ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ ‏"
Hadith_List.Matn_English: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Bilal pronounces the Adhan at night, so eat and drink (Suhur) till Ibn Um Maktum pronounces the Adhan."
Hadith_List.Other_References: In-book reference: Book 10, Hadith 20; USC-MSA web (English) reference: Vol. 1, Book 11, Hadith 596

Chapters.Chapter_Name_Arabic: باب كَمْ بَيْنَ الأَذَانِ وَالإِقَامَةِ وَمَنْ يَنْتَظِرُ الإِقَامَةَ
Chapters.Chapter_Name_English: Chapter: How long should the interval between the Adhan and the Iqama be? (And something concerning) the person who wants for the Iqama
